CREATE   VIEW
[inventar_SpcHidr].[vista_reclamo_diario_calculado]
AS

/* ========================================================================
   PAD 1 — CONTRATO PRODUCTIVO ACTUAL
========================================================================= */
SELECT
    p.fecha_reporte,
    p.pad_id,
    p.[campaña_id],
    p.modulo_id,
    p.volumen_diario_m3,
    p.avance_porcentaje,
    p.avance_incremental,
    p.tms_total_apilado,
    p.finos_totales_apilados,
    p.tonelaje_reclamado_diario,
    p.fecha_operacion,
    p.modulo_numero,
    p.avance_acumulado_pad,
    p.cantidad_modulos_fuente,
    p.tms_base_modulo,
    p.m3_totales,
    p.densidad_exacta,
    p.volumen_camiones_aprobado_m3,
    p.tms_camiones_aprobado,
    p.periodo_reporte,
    p.fecha_corte_camiones,
    p.estado_configuracion_corte,
    p.fuente_configuracion_corte,
    p.regla_corte_camiones,
    p.medicion_valida,
    p.motivo_medicion,
    p.fuente_control_medicion,
    p.fecha_estado_utilizado,
    p.regla_estado_topografico,
    p.campaña_anterior_pad,
    p.modulo_anterior_pad,
    p.modulo_numero_anterior_pad,
    p.avance_anterior_pad,
    p.tms_anterior_pad,
    p.metodo_calculo

FROM [inventar_SpcHidr].[vista_reclamo_diario_calculado_oxidos_of] p

WHERE p.pad_id = 1


UNION ALL


/* ========================================================================
   PAD 2 — V4.9 TOPOGRAFÍA, MAPEADA AL CONTRATO OFICIAL
========================================================================= */
SELECT
    CAST(s.fecha_reporte AS date)
        AS fecha_reporte,

    CAST(s.pad_id AS int)
        AS pad_id,

    CAST(s.[campaña_id] AS int)
        AS [campaña_id],

    CAST(s.modulo_id AS int)
        AS modulo_id,

    CAST(COALESCE(b.volumen_diario_m3, 0.0) AS float)
        AS volumen_diario_m3,

    CAST(s.avance_porcentaje AS float)
        AS avance_porcentaje,

    CAST(s.avance_incremental AS float)
        AS avance_incremental,

    CAST(s.tms_disponible_roto AS float)
        AS tms_total_apilado,

    CAST(COALESCE(b.finos_totales_apilados, 0.0) AS float)
        AS finos_totales_apilados,

    CAST(s.tonelaje_reclamado_diario AS float)
        AS tonelaje_reclamado_diario,

    CAST(s.fecha_operacion AS date)
        AS fecha_operacion,

    CAST(s.modulo_numero AS int)
        AS modulo_numero,

    CAST(b.avance_acumulado_pad AS float)
        AS avance_acumulado_pad,

    CAST(b.cantidad_modulos_fuente AS int)
        AS cantidad_modulos_fuente,

    CAST(b.tms_base_modulo AS float)
        AS tms_base_modulo,

    CAST(b.m3_totales AS float)
        AS m3_totales,

    CAST(b.densidad_exacta AS float)
        AS densidad_exacta,

    CAST(b.volumen_camiones_aprobado_m3 AS float)
        AS volumen_camiones_aprobado_m3,

    CAST(b.tms_camiones_aprobado AS float)
        AS tms_camiones_aprobado,

    CAST(b.periodo_reporte AS date)
        AS periodo_reporte,

    CAST(b.fecha_corte_camiones AS date)
        AS fecha_corte_camiones,

    CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN b.fecha_corte_sesion IS NOT NULL
                THEN 'CORTE_EXPLICITO_SP'
            WHEN b.estado_configuracion_corte = 'PERIODO_CERRADO'
                THEN 'PERIODO_CERRADO'
            ELSE 'PERIODO_ABIERTO'
        END
        AS varchar(20)
    ) AS estado_configuracion_corte,

    CAST(b.fuente_configuracion_corte AS varchar(150))
        AS fuente_configuracion_corte,

    CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN b.fecha_corte_sesion IS NOT NULL
                THEN 'CORTE_EXPLICITO_SP'
            WHEN b.estado_configuracion_corte = 'PERIODO_CERRADO'
                THEN 'CORTE_PERIODO_CERRADO'
            WHEN b.fecha_ultima_carga_periodo IS NOT NULL
                THEN 'CORTE_ULTIMA_CARGA'
            WHEN b.fecha_corte_camiones IS NOT NULL
                THEN 'CORTE_CONFIG_RESPALDO'
            ELSE 'SIN_CORTE_CAMIONES'
        END
        AS varchar(27)
    ) AS regla_corte_camiones,

    CAST(s.medicion_valida AS bit)
        AS medicion_valida,

    CAST(s.motivo_medicion AS varchar(250))
        AS motivo_medicion,

    CAST(b.fuente_control_medicion AS varchar(250))
        AS fuente_control_medicion,

    CAST(b.fecha_estado_utilizado AS date)
        AS fecha_estado_utilizado,

    CAST(b.regla_estado_topografico AS varchar(29))
        AS regla_estado_topografico,

    CAST(s.campaña_anterior AS int)
        AS campaña_anterior_pad,

    CAST(s.modulo_id_anterior AS int)
        AS modulo_anterior_pad,

    CAST(s.modulo_numero_anterior AS int)
        AS modulo_numero_anterior_pad,

    CAST(s.avance_topografia_anterior AS float)
        AS avance_anterior_pad,

    CAST(s.tms_disponible_anterior AS float)
        AS tms_anterior_pad,

    CAST(s.metodo_calculo AS varchar(34))
        AS metodo_calculo

FROM [inventar_SpcHidr].
     [vista_reclamo_diario_calculado_sulfuros_of] s

INNER JOIN [inventar_SpcHidr].
           [vista_reclamo_diario_calculado_sulfuros_base_of] b
    ON  b.fecha_operacion = s.fecha_operacion
    AND b.pad_id          = s.pad_id
    AND b.[campaña_id]    = s.[campaña_id]
    AND b.modulo_id       = s.modulo_id

WHERE s.pad_id = 2;

/* ================================================================
   FIX: reclamo.v_reclamo_para_conciliados descarta camiones de
   modulos que ese dia solo tuvieron camiones y ninguna medicion de
   rotopala (topografia, preliminar o ajuste).

   Causa raiz: el filtro WHERE rd.fuente_reclamo <> 'SIN_DATO' usa
   fuente_reclamo (que solo describe el origen del dato de ROTOPALA)
   como filtro de fila completa. Cuando fuente_reclamo = SIN_DATO
   por falta de rotopala ese dia, se pierde tambien el
   tms_camiones_dia de esa fila aunque sea distinto de cero.

   Evidencia 2026-07-01 PAD 2: modulos 192, 193, 194, 199, 200, 201
   tienen tms_camiones_dia > 0 y fuente_reclamo = SIN_DATO. Suma de
   esos seis modulos = 17995.070451, exactamente la diferencia que
   se observaba ese dia entre el dashboard (reclamo.calculo_diario)
   y la fuente del SP (reclamo.v_reclamo_para_conciliados).

   Fix: conservar la fila si hay fuente de rotopala valida O si hay
   camiones distintos de cero ese dia. Los modulos realmente vacios
   (sin rotopala y sin camiones) se siguen excluyendo igual que
   antes.

   No se toca reclamo.v_reclamo_diario (esa vista ya calcula bien
   tms_camiones_dia; el problema es solo el filtro de esta vista).
================================================================ */

CREATE VIEW [reclamo].[v_reclamo_para_conciliados]
AS
SELECT
    rd.fecha_operacion,
    rd.pad_id,
    rd.[campaña_id],
    rd.modulo_id,
    rd.modulo_numero,
    rd.rotopala_id,
    CAST(rd.avance_roto_pct AS float)              AS avance_porcentaje,
    CAST(rd.avance_total_pct_calculado AS float)   AS avance_total_porcentaje,
    CAST(rd.avance_camiones_pct AS float)          AS avance_camiones_porcentaje,
    CAST(rd.tms_rotopala_dia AS float)             AS tonelaje_reclamado_diario,
    CAST(rd.m3_rotopala_dia AS float)              AS volumen_diario_m3,
    CAST(rd.tms_camiones_dia AS float)             AS tonelaje_camiones_diario,
    CAST(rd.tms_disponible_roto AS float)          AS tms_disponible_roto,
    CAST(rd.tms_conformado AS float)               AS tms_conformado,
    CAST(rd.densidad_oficial AS float)             AS densidad_oficial,
    rd.fuente_reclamo,
    rd.metodo_calculo,
    rd.flag_calculo,
    rd.ajustes_aplicados
FROM [reclamo].[v_reclamo_diario] rd
WHERE rd.fuente_reclamo <> 'SIN_DATO'
   OR COALESCE(rd.tms_camiones_dia, 0) <> 0;

CREATE   PROCEDURE inventar_SpcHidr.sp_rep_publish_oficial_validado
    @run_id UNIQUEIDENTIFIER,
    @caso_id INT,
    @usuario_validacion NVARCHAR(128),
    @resumen_json NVARCHAR(MAX) = NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    DECLARE @fecha_inicio DATE = NULL;
    DECLARE @fecha_fin DATE = NULL;
    DECLARE @validation_id BIGINT = NULL;
    DECLARE @rows_published INT = 0;

    DECLARE @periodo TABLE
    (
        caso_id INT,
        fecha_inicio DATE,
        fecha_fin DATE
    );

    INSERT INTO @periodo(caso_id, fecha_inicio, fecha_fin)
    EXEC inventar_SpcHidr.sp_rep_get_periodo_caso @caso_id = @caso_id;

    SELECT TOP 1
        @fecha_inicio = fecha_inicio,
        @fecha_fin = fecha_fin
    FROM @periodo;

    IF @fecha_inicio IS NULL OR @fecha_fin IS NULL
    BEGIN
        THROW 50001, 'No se pudo obtener el período del caso.', 1;
    END;

    BEGIN TRANSACTION;

    BEGIN TRY
        IF OBJECT_ID('inventar_SpcHidr.rep_prod_validacion_log', 'U') IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO inventar_SpcHidr.rep_prod_validacion_log
            (
                run_id,
                caso_id,
                fecha_inicio,
                fecha_fin,
                decision,
                usuario_validacion,
                resumen_json
            )
            VALUES
            (
                @run_id,
                @caso_id,
                @fecha_inicio,
                @fecha_fin,
                'ACEPTADO',
                @usuario_validacion,
                @resumen_json
            );

            SET @validation_id = CAST(SCOPE_IDENTITY() AS BIGINT);
        END;

        DELETE FROM inventar_SpcHidr.Datos_conciliados_of_ver
        WHERE Fecha BETWEEN @fecha_inicio AND @fecha_fin;

        INSERT INTO inventar_SpcHidr.Datos_conciliados_of_ver
        (
            [Fecha],
            [Chancado_TMS_Real],
            [Humedad_Turno_A],
            [Humedad_Turno_B],
            [Humedad_promedio_dia],
            [Sal_turno_A],
            [Sal_Turno_B],
            [Sal_promedio_dia],
            [Apilado_TMH_turno_A],
            [Apilado_TMH_turno_B],
            [Apilado_TMH_promedio_dia],
            [Apilado_TMS_Real],
            [Apilado_TMS_Plan],
            [Campana_apilado],
            [Modulo_apilado],
            [Avance_apilado],
            [Ley_CuT_Real],
            [Ley_CuT_Plan],
            [Cobre_fino_Apilado_Real],
            [Cobre_fino_Apilado_Plan],
            [TMS_Rotopala_1_Real],
            [TMS_Rotopala_1_Plan],
            [Campana_reclamo_oxidos],
            [Modulo_reclamo_oxidos],
            [Avance_reclamo_oxidos],
            [TMS_Rotopala_2_Real],
            [TMS_Rotopala_2_Plan],
            [Campana_reclamo_sulfuros],
            [modulo_reclamo_sulfuros],
            [Avance_reclamo_sulfuros],
            [Camiones_TMS_Reclamo_Oxidos],
            [Camiones_TMS_Reclamo_Sulfuros],
            [Movido],
            [Extraido],
            [Camiones_TMS_total],
            [Camiones_TMS_plan],
            [Campana_reclamo_camiones],
            [Modulo_reclamo_camiones],
            [Total_Ripios_Incluye_Camiones_Real],
            [Total_Ripios_Incluye_Camiones_Plan],
            [Produccion_Catodos_Real],
            [Produccion_Catodos_Plan],
            [SRR_TMS_Turno_A],
            [SRR_TMS_Turno_B],
            [SRR_TMS_promedio_dia],
            [SRR_TMS_Plan],
            [Ley_CuT_Real_srr],
            [Ley_CuT_Plan_srr],
            [estado],
            [run_id],
            [caso_id],
            [version_reglas],
            [ts_ajuste],
            [es_activa],
            [origen],
            [comentario],
            [fecha_validacion],
            [usuario_validacion],
            [estado_validacion],
            [validation_id]
        )
        SELECT
            s.[Fecha],
            s.[Chancado_TMS_Real],
            s.[Humedad_Turno_A],
            s.[Humedad_Turno_B],
            s.[Humedad_promedio_dia],
            s.[Sal_turno_A],
            s.[Sal_Turno_B],
            s.[Sal_promedio_dia],
            s.[Apilado_TMH_turno_A],
            s.[Apilado_TMH_turno_B],
            s.[Apilado_TMH_promedio_dia],
            s.[Apilado_TMS_Real],
            s.[Apilado_TMS_Plan],
            s.[Campana_apilado],
            s.[Modulo_apilado],
            s.[Avance_apilado],
            s.[Ley_CuT_Real],
            s.[Ley_CuT_Plan],
            s.[Cobre_fino_Apilado_Real],
            s.[Cobre_fino_Apilado_Plan],
            s.[TMS_Rotopala_1_Real],
            s.[TMS_Rotopala_1_Plan],
            s.[Campana_reclamo_oxidos],
            s.[Modulo_reclamo_oxidos],
            s.[Avance_reclamo_oxidos],
            s.[TMS_Rotopala_2_Real],
            s.[TMS_Rotopala_2_Plan],
            s.[Campana_reclamo_sulfuros],
            s.[modulo_reclamo_sulfuros],
            s.[Avance_reclamo_sulfuros],
            s.[Camiones_TMS_Reclamo_Oxidos],
            s.[Camiones_TMS_Reclamo_Sulfuros],
            s.[Movido],
            s.[Extraido],
            s.[Camiones_TMS_total],
            s.[Camiones_TMS_plan],
            s.[Campana_reclamo_camiones],
            s.[Modulo_reclamo_camiones],
            s.[Total_Ripios_Incluye_Camiones_Real],
            s.[Total_Ripios_Incluye_Camiones_Plan],
            s.[Produccion_Catodos_Real],
            s.[Produccion_Catodos_Plan],
            s.[SRR_TMS_Turno_A],
            s.[SRR_TMS_Turno_B],
            s.[SRR_TMS_promedio_dia],
            s.[SRR_TMS_Plan],
            s.[Ley_CuT_Real_srr],
            s.[Ley_CuT_Plan_srr],
            ISNULL(s.[estado], 1),
            @run_id,
            @caso_id,
            ISNULL(s.[version_reglas], 1),
            ISNULL(s.[ts_ajuste], SYSUTCDATETIME()),
            CAST(1 AS bit),
            N'AJUSTE_REPORTE',
            N'Publicado desde rep_prod_ajustado_stg tras aceptación en modal',
            SYSDATETIME(),
            @usuario_validacion,
            'VALIDADO',
            @validation_id
        FROM inventar_SpcHidr.rep_prod_ajustado_stg s
        WHERE s.run_id = @run_id
          AND s.caso_id = @caso_id
          AND s.Fecha BETWEEN @fecha_inicio AND @fecha_fin
        ORDER BY s.Fecha;

        SET @rows_published = @@ROWCOUNT;

        IF @rows_published = 0
        BEGIN
            THROW 50002, 'No se encontraron filas en rep_prod_ajustado_stg para publicar.', 1;
        END;

        IF @validation_id IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
            UPDATE inventar_SpcHidr.rep_prod_validacion_log
            SET filas_publicadas = @rows_published
            WHERE validation_id = @validation_id;
        END;

        COMMIT TRANSACTION;

        SELECT
            @validation_id AS validation_id,
            @rows_published AS rows_published;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;

        DECLARE @msg NVARCHAR(4000) = ERROR_MESSAGE();
        THROW 50003, @msg, 1;
    END CATCH
END

CREATE   VIEW inventar_SpcHidr.vw_datos_conciliados_reporte

        [Humedad_Turno_B],
        [Humedad_promedio_dia],

        [Sal_promedio_dia],

        [Apilado_TMH_promedio_dia],
        [Apilado_TMS_Real],
        [Apilado_TMS_Plan],
        [Campana_apilado],
        [Modulo_apilado],
        [Avance_apilado],
        [Ley_CuT_Real],
        [Ley_CuT_Plan],
        [Cobre_fino_Apilado_Real],
        [Cobre_fino_Apilado_Plan],
        [TMS_Rotopala_1_Real],
        [TMS_Rotopala_1_Plan],
        [Campana_reclamo_oxidos],
        [Modulo_reclamo_oxidos],
        [Avance_reclamo_oxidos],
        [TMS_Rotopala_2_Real],
        [TMS_Rotopala_2_Plan],
        [Campana_reclamo_sulfuros],
        [modulo_reclamo_sulfuros],
        [Avance_reclamo_sulfuros],
        [Camiones_TMS_Reclamo_Oxidos],
        [Camiones_TMS_Reclamo_Sulfuros],
        [Movido],
        [Extraido],
        [Camiones_TMS_total],
        [Camiones_TMS_plan],
        [Campana_reclamo_camiones],
        [Modulo_reclamo_camiones],
        [Total_Ripios_Incluye_Camiones_Real],
        [Total_Ripios_Incluye_Camiones_Plan],

        b.[Humedad_Turno_B],
        b.[Humedad_promedio_dia],

        b.[Modulo_apilado],
        b.[Avance_apilado],
        b.[Ley_CuT_Real],
        b.[Ley_CuT_Plan],
        b.[Cobre_fino_Apilado_Real],
        b.[Cobre_fino_Apilado_Plan],
        b.[TMS_Rotopala_1_Real],
        b.[TMS_Rotopala_1_Plan],
        b.[Campana_reclamo_oxidos],
        b.[Modulo_reclamo_oxidos],
        b.[Avance_reclamo_oxidos],
        b.[TMS_Rotopala_2_Real],
        b.[TMS_Rotopala_2_Plan],
        b.[Campana_reclamo_sulfuros],
        b.[modulo_reclamo_sulfuros],
        b.[Avance_reclamo_sulfuros],
        b.[Camiones_TMS_Reclamo_Oxidos],
        b.[Camiones_TMS_Reclamo_Sulfuros],
        b.[Movido],
        b.[Extraido],
        b.[Camiones_TMS_total],
        b.[Camiones_TMS_plan],
        b.[Campana_reclamo_camiones],
        b.[Modulo_reclamo_camiones],
        b.[Total_Ripios_Incluye_Camiones_Real],
        b.[Total_Ripios_Incluye_Camiones_Plan],
        b.[Produccion_Catodos_Real],
        b.[Produccion_Catodos_Plan],
        CAST(0 AS INT) AS [Estado],
        CAST(1 AS BIT) AS [es_preliminar],
        CAST(0 AS BIT) AS [es_oficial],
        CAST('PROVISORIO' AS VARCHAR(20)) AS [fuente_reporte]
    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.Datos_conciliados_of b
    LEFT JOIN oficial o
        ON b.[Fecha] = o.[Fecha]
    WHERE o.[Fecha] IS NULL
)
SELECT *
FROM oficial

UNION ALL

SELECT *
FROM provisorio;

CREATE   VIEW inventar_SpcHidr.vw_datos_conciliados_publicacion_base
AS
WITH HumedadesLimpio AS (
    SELECT
        CAST(Fecha AS date) AS Fecha,
        AVG(Humedades_Turno_A) AS Humedad_Turno_A,
        AVG(Humedades_Turno_B) AS Humedad_Turno_B,
        AVG(Humedades_Dia)     AS Humedad_promedio_dia
    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.import_leyes_torres
    GROUP BY CAST(Fecha AS date)
),

LeySrrDiaria AS (
    SELECT
        CAST(Fecha AS date) AS Fecha,
        CASE
            WHEN SUM(Ton) IS NULL OR SUM(Ton) = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE SUM(Ton * CuTG00) / SUM(Ton)
        END AS Ley_CuT_Real_srr
    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.mov_cam
    WHERE Fase = 'SRR'
    GROUP BY CAST(Fecha AS date)
),

LeyMineralDiaria AS (
    SELECT
        CAST(Fecha AS date) AS Fecha,
        CASE
            WHEN SUM(Ton) IS NULL OR SUM(Ton) = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE SUM(Ton * CuTG00) / SUM(Ton)
        END AS Ley_CuT_Real
    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.mov_cam
    WHERE Fase IN ('Apilado', 'Chancado')
    GROUP BY CAST(Fecha AS date)
),

PlanMensualDiario AS (
    SELECT
        CAST(fecha AS date) AS Fecha,

        mineral_tms       AS Apilado_TMS_Plan,
        ley_cut_global    AS Ley_CuT_Plan,
        cu_fino_total     AS Cobre_fino_Apilado_Plan,

        mineral_srr_tms   AS SRR_TMS_Plan,
        ley_cut_srr       AS Ley_CuT_Plan_srr,

        rotopala_oxido    AS TMS_Rotopala_1_Plan,
        rotopala_sulfuro  AS TMS_Rotopala_2_Plan,

        camiones_sulfuros AS Camiones_TMS_plan,
        cosecha_mdc       AS Produccion_Catodos_Plan,

        (rotopala_oxido + rotopala_sulfuro + camiones_sulfuros)
            AS Total_Ripios_Incluye_Camiones_Plan

    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.plan_mensual_hidro
),

ResumenTurnos AS (
    SELECT
        CAST(Fecha AS date) AS Fecha,

        SUM(COALESCE(cv201_tot_TurnoA, 0)) AS cv201_tot_TurnoA,
        SUM(COALESCE(cv201_tot_TurnoB, 0)) AS cv201_tot_TurnoB,
        SUM(COALESCE(cv201_tot_Dia, 0))    AS cv201_tot_Dia,

        SUM(COALESCE(cv202_tot_TurnoA, 0)) AS cv202_tot_TurnoA,
        SUM(COALESCE(cv202_tot_TurnoB, 0)) AS cv202_tot_TurnoB,
        SUM(COALESCE(cv202_tot_Dia, 0))    AS cv202_tot_Dia,

        SUM(COALESCE(cv001_tot_TurnoA, 0)) AS cv001_tot_TurnoA,
        SUM(COALESCE(cv001_tot_TurnoB, 0)) AS cv001_tot_TurnoB,
        SUM(COALESCE(cv001_tot_Dia, 0))    AS cv001_tot_Dia,

        /* APILADO EN BASE HÚMEDA */
        SUM(COALESCE(apilado_ton_TurnoA, 0)) AS apilado_tmh_TurnoA,
        SUM(COALESCE(apilado_ton_TurnoB, 0)) AS apilado_tmh_TurnoB,
        SUM(COALESCE(apilado_ton_Dia, 0))    AS apilado_tmh_Dia
    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.vista_resumen_turnos_dia
    GROUP BY CAST(Fecha AS date)
),

ChancadoData AS (
    SELECT
        CAST(fecha_turno AS date) AS Fecha,
        SUM(COALESCE(cv006_tot, 0)) AS Chancado_TMH
    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.vista_resumen_datos_filtrados
    GROUP BY CAST(fecha_turno AS date)
),

ApiladoControlRanking AS (
    SELECT
        cad.modulo,
        cad.avance_porcentaje,
        cad.volumen_diario_m3,
        CAST(cad.fecha AS date) AS fecha_control,
        cad.pad_id,
        p.nombre AS pad_nombre,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY CAST(cad.fecha AS date)
            ORDER BY
                cad.modulo DESC,
                cad.avance_porcentaje DESC,
                cad.volumen_diario_m3 DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.control_apilado_diario cad
    INNER JOIN inventar_SpcHidr.pad p
        ON cad.pad_id = p.id_pad
    WHERE cad.volumen_diario_m3 > 0
),

ApiladoControlDiario AS (
    SELECT
        modulo,
        avance_porcentaje,
        volumen_diario_m3,
        CAST(DATEADD(DAY, -1, fecha_control) AS date) AS Fecha,
        pad_id,
        pad_nombre
    FROM ApiladoControlRanking
    WHERE rn = 1
),

FechasBase AS (
    SELECT Fecha FROM HumedadesLimpio
    UNION
    SELECT Fecha FROM LeySrrDiaria
    UNION
    SELECT Fecha FROM LeyMineralDiaria
    UNION
    SELECT Fecha FROM PlanMensualDiario
    UNION
    SELECT Fecha FROM ResumenTurnos
    UNION
    SELECT Fecha FROM ChancadoData
    UNION
    SELECT Fecha FROM ApiladoControlDiario
)

SELECT
    fb.Fecha,

    /* CHANCADO */
    CASE
        WHEN ch.Chancado_TMH IS NULL THEN NULL
        ELSE ch.Chancado_TMH * (100.0 - COALESCE(h.Humedad_promedio_dia, 0)) / 100.0
    END AS Chancado_TMS_Real,

    /* HUMEDADES */
    h.Humedad_Turno_A,
    h.Humedad_Turno_B,
    h.Humedad_promedio_dia,

    /* SAL = CV201 + CV202 */
    (COALESCE(r.cv201_tot_TurnoA, 0) + COALESCE(r.cv202_tot_TurnoA, 0)) AS Sal_turno_A,
    (COALESCE(r.cv201_tot_TurnoB, 0) + COALESCE(r.cv202_tot_TurnoB, 0)) AS Sal_Turno_B,
    (COALESCE(r.cv201_tot_Dia, 0)    + COALESCE(r.cv202_tot_Dia, 0))    AS Sal_promedio_dia,

    /* APILADO TMH */
    COALESCE(r.apilado_tmh_TurnoA, 0) AS Apilado_TMH_turno_A,
    COALESCE(r.apilado_tmh_TurnoB, 0) AS Apilado_TMH_turno_B,
    COALESCE(r.apilado_tmh_Dia, 0)    AS Apilado_TMH_promedio_dia,

    /* APILADO TMS */
    (
        COALESCE(r.apilado_tmh_Dia, 0)
        * (100.0 - COALESCE(h.Humedad_promedio_dia, 0)) / 100.0
    ) AS Apilado_TMS_Real,

    pm.Apilado_TMS_Plan,

    /* APILADO CONTEXTO OPERACIONAL */
    CAST(ac.pad_nombre AS nvarchar(255)) AS Campana_apilado,
    CAST(ac.modulo AS int) AS Modulo_apilado,
    CAST(ac.avance_porcentaje AS float) AS Avance_apilado,

    /* LEY MINERAL Y FINOS */
    lm.Ley_CuT_Real,
    pm.Ley_CuT_Plan,

    (
        (
            COALESCE(r.apilado_tmh_Dia, 0)
            * (100.0 - COALESCE(h.Humedad_promedio_dia, 0)) / 100.0
        )
        * COALESCE(lm.Ley_CuT_Real, 0) / 100.0
    ) AS Cobre_fino_Apilado_Real,

    pm.Cobre_fino_Apilado_Plan,

    /* ROTOPALAS */
    CAST(NULL AS float) AS TMS_Rotopala_1_Real,
    pm.TMS_Rotopala_1_Plan,
    CAST(NULL AS nvarchar(255)) AS Campana_reclamo_oxidos,
    CAST(NULL AS int) AS Modulo_reclamo_oxidos,
    CAST(NULL AS float) AS Avance_reclamo_oxidos,

    CAST(NULL AS float) AS TMS_Rotopala_2_Real,
    pm.TMS_Rotopala_2_Plan,
    CAST(NULL AS nvarchar(255)) AS Campana_reclamo_sulfuros,
    CAST(NULL AS int) AS modulo_reclamo_sulfuros,
    CAST(NULL AS float) AS Avance_reclamo_sulfuros,

    /* CAMIONES / RIPIOS */
    CAST(NULL AS float) AS Camiones_TMS_Reclamo_Oxidos,
    CAST(NULL AS float) AS Camiones_TMS_Reclamo_Sulfuros,
    CAST(NULL AS nvarchar(255)) AS Movido,
    CAST(NULL AS nvarchar(255)) AS Extraido,
    CAST(NULL AS float) AS Camiones_TMS_total,
    CAST(pm.Camiones_TMS_plan AS int) AS Camiones_TMS_plan,
    CAST(NULL AS nvarchar(255)) AS Campana_reclamo_camiones,
    CAST(NULL AS nvarchar(255)) AS Modulo_reclamo_camiones,
    CAST(NULL AS float) AS Total_Ripios_Incluye_Camiones_Real,
    pm.Total_Ripios_Incluye_Camiones_Plan,

    /* PRODUCCIÓN */
    CAST(NULL AS float) AS Produccion_Catodos_Real,
    CAST(pm.Produccion_Catodos_Plan AS int) AS Produccion_Catodos_Plan,

    /* SRR = CV001 */
    COALESCE(r.cv001_tot_TurnoA, 0) AS SRR_TMS_Turno_A,
    COALESCE(r.cv001_tot_TurnoB, 0) AS SRR_TMS_Turno_B,
    COALESCE(r.cv001_tot_Dia, 0)    AS SRR_TMS_promedio_dia,
    pm.SRR_TMS_Plan,
    ls.Ley_CuT_Real_srr,
    pm.Ley_CuT_Plan_srr,

    /* ESTADO BASE */
    CAST(0 AS int) AS estado_base_publicacion,

    /* CAMPOS AUXILIARES PARA UI / STAGING */
    CAST(ac.pad_id AS int) AS Pad_id_apilado,
    CAST(ac.volumen_diario_m3 AS float) AS Volumen_diario_m3_apilado,

    /* FLAGS CALIDAD */
    CASE WHEN h.Humedad_promedio_dia IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS flg_humedad,
    CASE WHEN (COALESCE(r.cv201_tot_Dia, 0) + COALESCE(r.cv202_tot_Dia, 0)) <> 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS flg_sal,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(r.cv001_tot_Dia, 0) <> 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS flg_srr,
    CASE WHEN lm.Ley_CuT_Real IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS flg_ley_mineral,
    CASE WHEN ls.Ley_CuT_Real_srr IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS flg_ley_srr,

    CASE
        WHEN
            (CASE WHEN h.Humedad_promedio_dia IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
            (CASE WHEN (COALESCE(r.cv201_tot_Dia, 0) + COALESCE(r.cv202_tot_Dia, 0)) <> 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
            (CASE WHEN COALESCE(r.cv001_tot_Dia, 0) <> 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
            (CASE WHEN lm.Ley_CuT_Real IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
            (CASE WHEN ls.Ley_CuT_Real_srr IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
            >= 5
        THEN 'COMPLETO'
        WHEN
            (CASE WHEN h.Humedad_promedio_dia IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
            (CASE WHEN (COALESCE(r.cv201_tot_Dia, 0) + COALESCE(r.cv202_tot_Dia, 0)) <> 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
            (CASE WHEN COALESCE(r.cv001_tot_Dia, 0) <> 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
            (CASE WHEN lm.Ley_CuT_Real IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
            (CASE WHEN ls.Ley_CuT_Real_srr IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
            >= 3
        THEN 'PARCIAL'
        ELSE 'CRITICO'
    END AS nivel_completitud

FROM FechasBase fb
LEFT JOIN HumedadesLimpio h
    ON fb.Fecha = h.Fecha
LEFT JOIN ResumenTurnos r
    ON fb.Fecha = r.Fecha
LEFT JOIN ChancadoData ch
    ON fb.Fecha = ch.Fecha
LEFT JOIN LeySrrDiaria ls
    ON fb.Fecha = ls.Fecha
LEFT JOIN LeyMineralDiaria lm
    ON fb.Fecha = lm.Fecha
LEFT JOIN PlanMensualDiario pm
    ON fb.Fecha = pm.Fecha
LEFT JOIN ApiladoControlDiario ac
    ON fb.Fecha = ac.Fecha;

CREATE PROCEDURE [inventar_SpcHidr].[sp_calcular_balance_flujos_copy1]
(
    @fecha_inicio date,
    @fecha_fin    date
)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 0) NORMALIZAR FECHAS
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    IF @fecha_inicio > @fecha_fin
    BEGIN
        DECLARE @tmp date = @fecha_inicio;
        SET @fecha_inicio = @fecha_fin;
        SET @fecha_fin = @tmp;
    END;
    DECLARE @ff_mas_1 date = DATEADD(DAY, 1, @fecha_fin);
    -- Dias del periodo a balancear (inclusive), usado por el criterio de evaporacion (seccion 8, F61/F62/F64/F71/F72/F74/F75/F77)
    DECLARE @dias_periodo int = DATEDIFF(DAY, @fecha_inicio, @fecha_fin) + 1;
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 1) TABLA TEMPORAL DE RESULTADOS
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#flujos_resultado') IS NOT NULL
        DROP TABLE #flujos_resultado;
    CREATE TABLE #flujos_resultado
    (
        codigo_flujo varchar(10)  NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
        TMS_Inicial  decimal(18,6) NULL,
        Ley_Cu_1     decimal(18,6) NULL,
        TMS_Final    decimal(18,6) NULL,
        Ley_Cu_2     decimal(18,6) NULL,
        Tonelaje     decimal(18,6) NULL,
        Ley_Cu       decimal(18,6) NULL
    );
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 2) FLUJOS BASE F1..F15, F20..F25
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------
/* ================================================================
   BASE COMUN F1 - F2 - F3
   ----------------------------------------------------------------
   PRIORIDAD POR FECHA:
       1. MOV_CAM
       2. POWER BI solo si NO existe MOV_CAM para esa fecha

   MAPEO POWER BI VALIDADO:
       tipo_movimiento = 'REMANEJO' -> STOCK
       tipo_movimiento = 'EXPIT'    -> MINA

       mov_cam.Ton     -> mov_cam_powerbi.tonelaje_descarga_tms
       mov_cam.CuTG00  -> mov_cam_powerbi.cut_ponderado

   IMPORTANTE:
       La sustitucion es por DIA COMPLETO.
       Si existe MOV_CAM para una fecha, no se mezcla POWER BI
       para esa misma fecha.
================================================================ */

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #Base_F123;

;WITH FechasMovCam AS
(
    SELECT DISTINCT
        CAST(m.fecha AS date) AS Fecha
    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.mov_cam m
    WHERE CAST(m.fecha AS date) BETWEEN @fecha_inicio AND @fecha_fin
      AND m.Fase <> 'SRR'
      AND m.Destino = 'CH01'
),
Base_F123 AS
(
    /* ============================================================
       1. FUENTE OFICIAL: MOV_CAM
       ============================================================ */
    SELECT
        CAST(m.fecha AS date) AS Fecha,

CASE
    WHEN UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(m.Origen, ''))))
         IN ('STOCK', 'REMANEJO')
        THEN 'Stock'

    WHEN UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(m.Origen, ''))))
         IN ('MINA', 'EXPIT')
        THEN 'Mina'

    ELSE m.Origen
END AS Origen,

        TRY_CONVERT(float, m.Ton)     AS Ton,
        TRY_CONVERT(float, m.CuTG00)  AS CuTG00,

        CAST('MOV_CAM' AS varchar(30)) AS Fuente

    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.mov_cam m

    WHERE CAST(m.fecha AS date) BETWEEN @fecha_inicio AND @fecha_fin
      AND m.Fase <> 'SRR'
      AND m.Destino = 'CH01'


    UNION ALL


    /* ============================================================
       2. FALLBACK: POWER BI
       Solo dias donde no existe MOV_CAM
       ============================================================ */
    SELECT
        CAST(p.fecha AS date) AS Fecha,

        CASE
            WHEN UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(p.tipo_movimiento, ''))))
                 = 'REMANEJO'
                THEN 'Stock'

            WHEN UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(p.tipo_movimiento, ''))))
                 = 'EXPIT'
                THEN 'Mina'

            ELSE NULL
        END AS Origen,

        TRY_CONVERT(float, p.tonelaje_descarga_tms) AS Ton,
        TRY_CONVERT(float, p.cut_ponderado)          AS CuTG00,

        CAST('POWERBI_PRELIMINAR' AS varchar(30)) AS Fuente

    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.mov_cam_powerbi p

    WHERE CAST(p.fecha AS date) BETWEEN @fecha_inicio AND @fecha_fin

      AND UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(p.fase, '')))) <> 'SRR'

      AND UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(p.destino_descarga, ''))))
          = 'CH01'

      AND NOT EXISTS
      (
          SELECT 1
          FROM FechasMovCam mc
          WHERE mc.Fecha = CAST(p.fecha AS date)
      )
)

SELECT
    Fecha,
    Origen,
    Ton,
    CuTG00,
    Fuente
INTO #Base_F123
FROM Base_F123;


/* ================================================================
   F1 - STOCK
   MOV_CAM  : Origen = Stock
   POWER BI : tipo_movimiento = REMANEJO
================================================================ */
INSERT INTO #flujos_resultado
(
    codigo_flujo,
    Tonelaje,
    Ley_Cu
)
SELECT
    'F1',

    ISNULL(
        SUM(Ton),
        0
    ),

    ISNULL(
        (
            SUM(Ton * CuTG00 / 100.0)
            /
            NULLIF(SUM(Ton), 0)
        ) * 100.0,
        0
    )

FROM #Base_F123
WHERE Origen = 'Stock';


/* ================================================================
   F2 - MINA
   MOV_CAM  : Origen = Mina
   POWER BI : tipo_movimiento = EXPIT
================================================================ */
INSERT INTO #flujos_resultado
(
    codigo_flujo,
    Tonelaje,
    Ley_Cu
)
SELECT
    'F2',

    ISNULL(
        SUM(Ton),
        0
    ),

    ISNULL(
        (
            SUM(Ton * CuTG00 / 100.0)
            /
            NULLIF(SUM(Ton), 0)
        ) * 100.0,
        0
    )

FROM #Base_F123
WHERE Origen = 'Mina';


/* ================================================================
   F3 - TOTAL ALIMENTACION CH01 NO SRR

   Mantiene la logica del SP actual:
   F3 no filtra por Origen.
================================================================ */
INSERT INTO #flujos_resultado
(
    codigo_flujo,
    Tonelaje,
    Ley_Cu
)
SELECT
    'F3',

    ISNULL(
        SUM(Ton),
        0
    ),

    ISNULL(
        (
            SUM(Ton * CuTG00 / 100.0)
            /
            NULLIF(SUM(Ton), 0)
        ) * 100.0,
        0
    )

FROM #Base_F123;

/* ================================================================
   F4 - DESCARGA SECA CHANCADO CV006 HACIA SILO
   ----------------------------------------------------------------
   TONELAJE:
       Fuente  : vista_resumen_datos_filtrados.CV006_tot
       Humedad : 2.5 %
       TMS     : SUM(CV006_tot) * 0.975

   LEY Cu:
       Se utiliza la Ley_Cu calculada para F3.

       F3 ya resuelve la jerarquia:
           1. MOV_CAM
           2. POWER BI preliminar cuando falta MOV_CAM

       Esto es equivalente a la logica historica de F4, ya que
       F3 y F4 utilizaban exactamente la misma ley de cabeza:
           Fase <> 'SRR'
           Destino = 'CH01'

   IMPORTANTE:
       Power BI NO reemplaza el tonelaje de F4.
       El tonelaje de F4 sigue viniendo de CV006.
================================================================ */

INSERT INTO #flujos_resultado
(
    codigo_flujo,
    Tonelaje,
    Ley_Cu
)
SELECT
    'F4',

    ROUND(
        COALESCE(
            (
                SELECT SUM(v.CV006_tot)
                FROM inventar_SpcHidr.vista_resumen_datos_filtrados v
                WHERE v.fecha_turno >= @fecha_inicio
                  AND v.fecha_turno < DATEADD(DAY, 1, @fecha_fin)
            ),
            0
        ) * 0.975,
        2
    ) AS Tonelaje,

    COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT f3.Ley_Cu
            FROM #flujos_resultado f3
            WHERE f3.codigo_flujo = 'F3'
        ),
        0
    ) AS Ley_Cu;
/* ================================================================
   F5 - DELTA INVENTARIO CHANCADO
   ----------------------------------------------------------------
   NUEVA FUENTE DE INVENTARIO:
       inventar_SpcHidr.v_inventario_chancado_test

   INVENTARIO:
       Apertura periodo:
           Inventario_Chancado_TMS_Anterior de @fecha_inicio

       Cierre periodo:
           Total_Inventario_Chancado_TMS de @fecha_fin

       Delta:
           Cierre - Apertura

   La vista ya incorpora:
       - Silo A-B
       - Harnero A-E
       - Chancado A-E
       - Tolva de compensacion
       - Humedad de inventario
       - Validacion Archive Value
       - Continuidad diaria / semilla

   LEY Cu:
       Se mantiene la metodologia vigente del F5:
       ley CH01 no-SRR en los extremos.

       La fuente de ley respeta ahora:
           MOV_CAM > POWERBI_PRELIMINAR

   IMPORTANTE:
       #Base_F123 debe seguir existiendo hasta terminar F5.
================================================================ */

;WITH
inv_i AS
(
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN MAX(i.Flag_Continuidad_Diaria) = 1
             AND MAX(i.Flag_Inventario_Valido) = 1
            THEN MAX(
                TRY_CONVERT(
                    float,
                    i.Inventario_Chancado_TMS_Anterior
                )
            )
            ELSE NULL
        END AS total_tms

    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.v_inventario_chancado_test i

    WHERE i.Fecha = @fecha_inicio
),

inv_f AS
(
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN MAX(i.Flag_Inventario_Valido) = 1
            THEN MAX(
                TRY_CONVERT(
                    float,
                    i.Total_Inventario_Chancado_TMS
                )
            )
            ELSE NULL
        END AS total_tms

    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.v_inventario_chancado_test i

    WHERE i.Fecha = @fecha_fin
),

/* ============================================================
   Ley inicial

   Utiliza la misma base normalizada F1-F3:
       MOV_CAM cuando existe
       POWER BI cuando falta MOV_CAM
   ============================================================ */
ley_i AS
(
    SELECT
        (
            SUM(Ton * CuTG00 / 100.0)
            /
            NULLIF(SUM(Ton), 0)
        ) * 100.0 AS ley_cu

    FROM #Base_F123

    WHERE Fecha = @fecha_inicio
),

/* ============================================================
   Ley final
   ============================================================ */
ley_f AS
(
    SELECT
        (
            SUM(Ton * CuTG00 / 100.0)
            /
            NULLIF(SUM(Ton), 0)
        ) * 100.0 AS ley_cu

    FROM #Base_F123

    WHERE Fecha = @fecha_fin
)

INSERT INTO #flujos_resultado
(
    codigo_flujo,
    TMS_Inicial,
    Ley_Cu_1,
    TMS_Final,
    Ley_Cu_2,
    Tonelaje,
    Ley_Cu
)
SELECT
    'F5',

    /* Inventario apertura */
    inv_i.total_tms AS TMS_Inicial,

    /* Ley apertura */
    CASE
        WHEN inv_i.total_tms IS NULL
            THEN NULL
        ELSE COALESCE(
            ley_i.ley_cu,
            ley_f.ley_cu
        )
    END AS Ley_Cu_1,

    /* Inventario cierre */
    inv_f.total_tms AS TMS_Final,

    /* Ley cierre */
    CASE
        WHEN inv_f.total_tms IS NULL
            THEN NULL
        ELSE COALESCE(
            ley_f.ley_cu,
            ley_i.ley_cu
        )
    END AS Ley_Cu_2,

    /* Delta inventario */
    CASE
        WHEN inv_i.total_tms IS NULL
          OR inv_f.total_tms IS NULL
            THEN NULL

        ELSE
            inv_f.total_tms
            - inv_i.total_tms
    END AS Tonelaje,

    /* ============================================================
       Ley equivalente del delta de inventario
       ============================================================ */
    CASE
        WHEN inv_i.total_tms IS NULL
          OR inv_f.total_tms IS NULL
          OR (inv_f.total_tms - inv_i.total_tms) = 0
            THEN NULL

        ELSE
            (
                (
                    inv_f.total_tms
                    *
                    COALESCE(
                        ley_f.ley_cu,
                        ley_i.ley_cu
                    )
                    / 100.0
                )
                -
                (
                    inv_i.total_tms
                    *
                    COALESCE(
                        ley_i.ley_cu,
                        ley_f.ley_cu
                    )
                    / 100.0
                )
            )
            /
            NULLIF(
                inv_f.total_tms
                - inv_i.total_tms,
                0
            )
            * 100.0
    END AS Ley_Cu

FROM inv_i
CROSS JOIN inv_f
CROSS JOIN ley_i
CROSS JOIN ley_f;

/* ================================================================
   BASE COMUN LEY CuT SRR
   ----------------------------------------------------------------
   Consumidores:
       F8
       F9
       F25

   PRIORIDAD POR FECHA:
       1. MOV_CAM SRR válido
       2. IMP SRR solo si MOV_CAM no tiene ley válida ese día

   IMPORTANTE:
       - MOV_CAM e IMP no se mezclan dentro del mismo día.
       - Ton_Ponderador se utiliza SOLO para calcular la ley.
       - NO define la masa de F8, F9 ni F25.
================================================================ */

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #Ley_SRR_Dia;

;WITH MOV_CAM_SRR AS
(
    SELECT
        CAST(m.fecha AS date) AS Fecha,

        SUM
        (
            CASE
                WHEN TRY_CONVERT(float, m.Ton) > 0
                 AND TRY_CONVERT(float, m.CuTG00) IS NOT NULL
                THEN TRY_CONVERT(float, m.Ton)
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS Ton_Ponderador,

        SUM
        (
            CASE
                WHEN TRY_CONVERT(float, m.Ton) > 0
                 AND TRY_CONVERT(float, m.CuTG00) IS NOT NULL
                THEN
                    TRY_CONVERT(float, m.Ton)
                    * TRY_CONVERT(float, m.CuTG00)
                    / 100.0
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS FCu_Ponderador

    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.mov_cam AS m

    WHERE CAST(m.fecha AS date)
          BETWEEN @fecha_inicio AND @fecha_fin

      AND UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(m.Fase, '')))) = 'SRR'

      AND UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(m.Destino, ''))))
          IN ('PRUEBA', 'CH01')

    GROUP BY
        CAST(m.fecha AS date)
),

MOV_CAM_SRR_VALIDO AS
(
    SELECT
        Fecha,
        Ton_Ponderador,

        FCu_Ponderador
        / NULLIF(Ton_Ponderador, 0)
        * 100.0 AS CuT,

        CAST('MOV_CAM' AS varchar(20)) AS Fuente

    FROM MOV_CAM_SRR

    WHERE Ton_Ponderador > 0
),

IMP_SRR AS
(
    SELECT
        CAST(i.Fecha AS date) AS Fecha,

        SUM
        (
            CASE
                WHEN ISNULL(i.Es_SRR, 0) = 1
                 AND TRY_CONVERT(float, i.Ton) > 0
                 AND TRY_CONVERT(float, i.CuT) IS NOT NULL
                THEN TRY_CONVERT(float, i.Ton)
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS Ton_Ponderador,

        SUM
        (
            CASE
                WHEN ISNULL(i.Es_SRR, 0) = 1
                 AND TRY_CONVERT(float, i.Ton) > 0
                 AND TRY_CONVERT(float, i.CuT) IS NOT NULL
                THEN
                    TRY_CONVERT(float, i.Ton)
                    * TRY_CONVERT(float, i.CuT)
                    / 100.0
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS FCu_Ponderador

    FROM DEV_SIIR.hidro.v_imp_chancado_normalizado AS i

    WHERE CAST(i.Fecha AS date)
          BETWEEN @fecha_inicio AND @fecha_fin

      AND ISNULL(i.Es_SRR, 0) = 1

    GROUP BY
        CAST(i.Fecha AS date)
),

IMP_SRR_VALIDO AS
(
    SELECT
        Fecha,
        Ton_Ponderador,

        FCu_Ponderador
        / NULLIF(Ton_Ponderador, 0)
        * 100.0 AS CuT,

        CAST('IMP' AS varchar(20)) AS Fuente

    FROM IMP_SRR

    WHERE Ton_Ponderador > 0
),

LEY_SRR_FINAL AS
(
    /* MOV_CAM tiene prioridad */
    SELECT
        m.Fecha,
        m.Ton_Ponderador,
        m.CuT,
        m.Fuente

    FROM MOV_CAM_SRR_VALIDO AS m


    UNION ALL


    /* IMP rellena solamente días sin MOV_CAM válido */
    SELECT
        i.Fecha,
        i.Ton_Ponderador,
        i.CuT,
        i.Fuente

    FROM IMP_SRR_VALIDO AS i

    WHERE NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1
        FROM MOV_CAM_SRR_VALIDO AS m
        WHERE m.Fecha = i.Fecha
    )
)

SELECT
    Fecha,
    Ton_Ponderador,
    CuT,
    Fuente

INTO #Ley_SRR_Dia

FROM LEY_SRR_FINAL;

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #Base_F67;

;WITH Humedad AS
(
    SELECT
        Fecha,
        Turno,
        Humedad_TM1,
        Humedad_TM2

    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.fn_humedad_resuelta_tm_turno_test
    (
        @fecha_inicio,
        DATEADD(DAY, 1, @fecha_fin)
    )
),

TMH AS
(
    SELECT
        v.Fecha,
        x.Turno,
        x.TM,

        /* Protección ya validada para spikes de tonelaje */
        CASE
            WHEN ABS(COALESCE(x.TMH, 0)) > 150000
                THEN 0
            ELSE COALESCE(x.TMH, 0)
        END AS TMH

    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.v_datos_apilado_tmh_v2 AS v

    CROSS APPLY
    (
        VALUES
            ('A', 'TM1', v.TMH_CV008_A),
            ('B', 'TM1', v.TMH_CV008_B),

            ('A', 'TM2', v.TMH_CV108_A),
            ('B', 'TM2', v.TMH_CV108_B)
    ) AS x
    (
        Turno,
        TM,
        TMH
    )

    WHERE v.Fecha >= @fecha_inicio
      AND v.Fecha < DATEADD(DAY, 1, @fecha_fin)
),

Base AS
(
    SELECT
        t.Fecha,
        t.Turno,
        t.TM,
        t.TMH,

        CASE
            WHEN t.TM = 'TM1'
                THEN h.Humedad_TM1

            WHEN t.TM = 'TM2'
                THEN h.Humedad_TM2
        END AS Humedad,

        l.CuT,
        l.Fuente_CuT

    FROM TMH AS t

    LEFT JOIN Humedad AS h
        ON  h.Fecha = t.Fecha
        AND h.Turno = t.Turno

    LEFT JOIN inventar_SpcHidr.v_leyes_resueltas_data_tm_reporte_test AS l
        ON  l.Fecha = t.Fecha
        AND l.Turno = t.Turno
        AND l.TM    = t.TM
),

Calculo AS
(
    SELECT
        Fecha,
        Turno,
        TM,
        TMH,
        Humedad,
        CuT,
        Fuente_CuT,

        /* --------------------------------------------------------
           TMS BRUTO
           -------------------------------------------------------- */
        CASE
            WHEN TMH = 0
                THEN 0

            /* No inventar humedad */
            WHEN Humedad IS NULL
                THEN NULL

            ELSE
                TMH
                * (
                    1.0
                    - TRY_CONVERT(float, Humedad) / 100.0
                  )
        END AS TMS,

        /* --------------------------------------------------------
           COBRE FINO BRUTO
           -------------------------------------------------------- */
        CASE
            WHEN TMH = 0
                THEN 0

            WHEN Humedad IS NULL
              OR CuT IS NULL
                THEN NULL

            ELSE
                (
                    TMH
                    * (
                        1.0
                        - TRY_CONVERT(float, Humedad) / 100.0
                      )
                )
                * TRY_CONVERT(float, CuT)
                / 100.0
        END AS FCu

    FROM Base
),

Resumen AS
(
    SELECT
        TM,

        /* --------------------------------------------------------
           Si existe TMH positivo sin humedad, no omitir
           silenciosamente el turno.
           -------------------------------------------------------- */
        CASE
            WHEN SUM(
                    CASE
                        WHEN TMH > 0
                         AND Humedad IS NULL
                        THEN 1
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                 ) > 0
                THEN NULL

            ELSE SUM(TMS)
        END AS TMS_Bruto,

        /* --------------------------------------------------------
           Igual criterio para cobre fino.
           -------------------------------------------------------- */
        CASE
            WHEN SUM(
                    CASE
                        WHEN TMH > 0
                         AND (
                                Humedad IS NULL
                                OR CuT IS NULL
                             )
                        THEN 1
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                 ) > 0
                THEN NULL

            ELSE SUM(FCu)
        END AS FCu_Bruto,

        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN TMH > 0
                 AND Humedad IS NULL
                THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS Turnos_Sin_Humedad,

        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN TMH > 0
                 AND Humedad IS NOT NULL
                 AND CuT IS NULL
                THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS Turnos_Sin_CuT

    FROM Calculo

    GROUP BY TM
)

SELECT
    TM,
    TMS_Bruto,
    FCu_Bruto,
    Turnos_Sin_Humedad,
    Turnos_Sin_CuT

INTO #Base_F67

FROM Resumen;

                  b.TMS_Bruto
                - ISNULL(f.F8_TMS, 0)
                - ISNULL(f.F10_TMS, 0)

            WHEN b.TM = 'TM2'
            THEN
                  b.TMS_Bruto
                - ISNULL(f.F9_TMS, 0)
                - ISNULL(f.F11_TMS, 0)

        END AS TMS_Neto,


        /* ========================================================

           ======================================================== */

        CASE
            WHEN b.TM = 'TM1'
            THEN
                  b.FCu_Bruto
                - ISNULL(f.F8_FCu, 0)

            WHEN b.TM = 'TM2'
            THEN
                  b.FCu_Bruto
                - ISNULL(f.F9_FCu, 0)

        END AS FCu_Neto

    FROM #Base_F67 AS b

    CROSS JOIN Flujos_Aux AS f
),

F67_Final AS

            WHEN TMS_Neto = 0
                THEN 0

            ELSE
                FCu_Neto
                / NULLIF(TMS_Neto, 0)
                * 100.0

                THEN 0

            WHEN Humedad IS NULL
              OR CuT IS NULL
                THEN NULL

            ELSE
                (
                    TMH
                    *
                    (
                        1.0
                        - TRY_CONVERT(float, Humedad) / 100.0
                    )
                )
                * TRY_CONVERT(float, CuT)
                / 100.0

        END AS FCu

    FROM Base
),

Resumen_Diario AS
(
    SELECT
        Fecha,

        /* ========================================================
           TMS total TM1 + TM2 del día

           Si existe TMH positivo sin humedad, el día queda NULL.
           ======================================================== */
        CASE
            WHEN SUM
                 (
                     CASE
                         WHEN TMH > 0
                          AND Humedad IS NULL
                             THEN 1
                         ELSE 0
                     END
                 ) > 0
                THEN NULL

            ELSE SUM(TMS)

        END AS TMS_Dia,


        /* ========================================================
           Cobre fino total TM1 + TM2 del día

           Si falta humedad o CuT para un turno con masa positiva,
           no se omite silenciosamente.
           ======================================================== */
        CASE
            WHEN SUM
                 (
                     CASE
                         WHEN TMH > 0
                          AND
                              (
                                  Humedad IS NULL
                                  OR CuT IS NULL
                              )
                             THEN 1
                         ELSE 0
                     END
                 ) > 0
                THEN NULL

            ELSE SUM(FCu)

        END AS FCu_Dia,


        SUM
        (
            CASE
                WHEN TMH > 0
                 AND Humedad IS NULL
                    THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS Turnos_Sin_Humedad,


        SUM
        (
            CASE
                WHEN TMH > 0
                 AND Humedad IS NOT NULL
                 AND CuT IS NULL
                    THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS Turnos_Sin_CuT

    FROM Calculo

    GROUP BY Fecha
)

/* ================================================================
   F20 - RIPIO TOTAL MEDIDO POR CV025
   ----------------------------------------------------------------
   Fuente física:
       CV025 = correa común de las rotopalas asociadas a F18/F19.

   Señales disponibles:
       cv025tot  = señal histórica/legacy
       cv025_tot = señal nueva

   Regla:
       1. Construir una serie única a nivel de registro mediante:
              COALESCE(cv025_tot, cv025tot)

       2. Calcular el delta diario sobre esa serie.

       3. Proteger:
              - resets;
              - diferencias negativas;
              - saltos diarios > 100.000 TMH.

       4. Humedad operacional fija vigente:
              10 %

          TMS = TMH * 0.90

   IMPORTANTE:
       No se fuerza cierre contra F18/F19.
       CV025 es una medición independiente.
================================================================ */

;WITH CV025_Base AS
(
    SELECT
        CAST(df.fecha_turno AS date) AS Fecha,

        COALESCE
        (
            TRY_CONVERT(float, df.cv025_tot),
            TRY_CONVERT(float, df.cv025tot)
        ) AS CV025_Totalizador

    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.datos_filtrados AS df

    /*
       Se incluye el día siguiente a @fecha_fin porque necesitamos
       su primer totalizador para cerrar correctamente el último día.
    */
    WHERE df.fecha_turno >= @fecha_inicio
      AND df.fecha_turno < DATEADD(DAY, 2, @fecha_fin)
),

CV025_Dia AS
(
    SELECT
        Fecha,
        MIN(CV025_Totalizador) AS Min_CV025,
        MAX(CV025_Totalizador) AS Max_CV025

    FROM CV025_Base

    GROUP BY Fecha
),

CV025_Con_Siguiente AS
(
    SELECT
        Fecha,
        Min_CV025,
        Max_CV025,

        LEAD(Min_CV025)
            OVER (ORDER BY Fecha) AS Next_Min_CV025

    FROM CV025_Dia
),

CV025_Validado AS
(
    SELECT
        Fecha,

        CASE

            /* Sin señal válida */
            WHEN Min_CV025 IS NULL
              OR Max_CV025 IS NULL
                THEN 0

            /* Protección adicional */
            WHEN Max_CV025 - Min_CV025 < 0
                THEN 0

            /* Último día disponible:
               usar recorrido interno solo si es razonable */
            WHEN Next_Min_CV025 IS NULL
             AND Max_CV025 - Min_CV025
                 BETWEEN 0 AND 100000
                THEN Max_CV025 - Min_CV025

            WHEN Next_Min_CV025 IS NULL
                THEN 0

            /* Reset entre días:
               usar recorrido interno si éste es válido */
            WHEN Next_Min_CV025 - Min_CV025 < 0
             AND Max_CV025 - Min_CV025
                 BETWEEN 0 AND 100000
                THEN Max_CV025 - Min_CV025

            WHEN Next_Min_CV025 - Min_CV025 < 0
                THEN 0

            /* Operación normal */
            WHEN Next_Min_CV025 - Min_CV025
                 BETWEEN 0 AND 100000
                THEN Next_Min_CV025 - Min_CV025

            /* Fallback al recorrido interno */
            WHEN Max_CV025 - Min_CV025
                 BETWEEN 0 AND 100000
                THEN Max_CV025 - Min_CV025

            /* Spike no físicamente razonable */
            ELSE 0

        END AS CV025_TMH_Dia

    FROM CV025_Con_Siguiente
)

/* ================================================================
   4. TONELAJE F25

   Se separa histórico y Process Value para permitir períodos
   que crucen el 01-07-2026.
================================================================ */

;WITH F25_Historico AS
(
    SELECT
        SUM(
            TRY_CONVERT(float, v.cv001_tot)
        ) * 0.97 AS TMS

    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.vista_resumen_datos_filtrados AS v

    WHERE v.fecha_turno >= @fecha_inicio
      AND v.fecha_turno < DATEADD(DAY, 1, @fecha_fin)

      /* tot_001 todavía era totalizador antes de esta fecha */
      AND v.fecha_turno < '2026-07-01'
),

F25_ProcessValue AS
(
    SELECT
        SUM
        (
            TRY_CONVERT(float, t.tot_001)

            /* integración de t/h cada 10 segundos */
            * 10.0
            / 3600.0

        )
        /* humedad SRR = 3 % */
        * 0.97 AS TMS

    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.tot_tm AS t

    WHERE t.fecha_turno >=
          CASE
              WHEN @fecha_inicio < '2026-07-01'
                  THEN CONVERT(date, '2026-07-01')
              ELSE @fecha_inicio
          END

      AND t.fecha_turno <= @fecha_fin

      AND t.tot_001 IS NOT NULL

      /* Un Process Value negativo no representa flujo físico */
      AND TRY_CONVERT(float, t.tot_001) >= 0
),

F25_Tonelaje AS
(
    SELECT
          ISNULL(h.TMS, 0)
        + ISNULL(p.TMS, 0) AS TMS

    FROM F25_Historico AS h
    CROSS JOIN F25_ProcessValue AS p
),

F25_Ley AS
(
    SELECT
        SUM
        (
            l.Ton_Ponderador
            * l.CuT
            / 100.0
        )
        /
        NULLIF
        (
            SUM(l.Ton_Ponderador),
            0
        )
        * 100.0 AS Ley_Cu

    FROM #Ley_SRR_Dia AS l
)

            p.pad_id,
            p.[campaña_id],
            p.modulo_id,
            p.pct_clip AS avance_porcentaje,
            CASE
                WHEN (p.pct_clip - LAG(p.pct_clip, 1, 0) OVER (
                    PARTITION BY p.[campaña_id], p.modulo_id, p.pad_id, p.seg_id
                    ORDER BY p.fecha
                )) < 0 THEN 0
                ELSE (p.pct_clip - LAG(p.pct_clip, 1, 0) OVER (
                    PARTITION BY p.[campaña_id], p.modulo_id, p.pad_id, p.seg_id
                    ORDER BY p.fecha
                ))
            END AS avance_incremental
        FROM Pct_Seg_Id p
    ),
    Volumen_Diario AS (
        SELECT
            CAST(fecha AS date) AS fecha,
            pad_id,
            [campaña_id],
            modulo_id,
            MAX(volumen_diario_m3) AS vol_m3
        FROM inventar_SpcHidr.control_reclamo_diario
        WHERE CAST(fecha AS date)
          BETWEEN @fecha_inicio AND @fecha_fin
        GROUP BY CAST(fecha AS date), pad_id, [campaña_id], modulo_id
    ),
    Reclamo_Diario AS (
        SELECT
            a.fecha AS fecha_operacion,
            a.[campaña_id],
            a.modulo_id,
            (tm.tms_total_apilado * a.avance_incremental) AS tonelaje_reclamado_diario
        FROM Avance_Incremental_Diario a
        JOIN Tms_Apilado_Por_Modulo tm
          ON tm.[campaña_id] = a.[campaña_id]
         AND tm.modulo_id = a.modulo_id
        JOIN Volumen_Diario vd
          ON vd.fecha = a.fecha
         AND vd.pad_id = a.pad_id
         AND vd.[campaña_id] = a.[campaña_id]
         AND vd.modulo_id = a.modulo_id
        WHERE a.pad_id = 1
          AND vd.vol_m3 > 0
    ),
    Calculo_Tonelaje AS (
        SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.tonelaje_reclamado_diario), 0) AS Tonelaje
        FROM Reclamo_Diario r
        WHERE r.fecha_operacion BETWEEN @fecha_inicio AND @fecha_fin
    ),
    ModulosActivos AS (
        SELECT
            r.[campaña_id],

        FROM Reclamo_Diario r
        WHERE r.fecha_operacion BETWEEN @fecha_inicio AND @fecha_fin
        GROUP BY r.[campaña_id], r.modulo_id

    Calculo_Ley AS (

            COALESCE(

                    SUM(ma.tms_reclamado_modulo * clr.ley_ripio / 100.0)

            ON ma.modulo_id = m.id_modulo

        INNER JOIN inventar_SpcHidr.pad pd

        INNER JOIN inventar_SpcHidr.control_ley_ripio clr
            ON clr.Campana = c.[numero_campaña]
           AND clr.Parcela = p.numero
           AND UPPER(clr.PAD) LIKE UPPER(pd.nombre) + '%'
        WHERE pd.id_pad = 1
    )
    SELECT
        t.Tonelaje,
        l.Ley_Cu
    INTO #tmp_f19_oficial

   ----------------------------------------------------------------

       CuF38 = F38 * Ley38 / 100

       F33 + CuF38 = CuF35 + CuF37

   Como CuF35 = 0:

       F33 = CuF37 - CuF38

   F33 representa directamente toneladas de cobre fino:
       Ley F33 = 100 %
       CuF33    = F33
================================================================ */

;WITH F37 AS
(
    SELECT
        COALESCE(TRY_CONVERT(float, Tonelaje), 0) AS Tonelaje,
        COALESCE(TRY_CONVERT(float, Ley_Cu), 0)   AS Ley_Cu

        F37.Tonelaje

        F38.Tonelaje

)

       caudal_riego [m3/h]
       x duración real del intervalo [h]

   Densidad de solución:
       1 t/m3

   Conversión ley:
       g/L / 10 = % Cu
================================================================ */

;WITH Configuracion AS
(
    SELECT 'F39' AS codigo_flujo, 'OX' AS pila_codigo, 'REFINO' AS origen_riego
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'F41', 'OX',   'ILS'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'F46', 'OX',   'DPLS'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'F44', 'SULF', 'REFINO'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'F45', 'SULF', 'ILS'
),

/* ================================================================
   Concentraciones diarias

   Se consolida por fecha para impedir multiplicación de filas
   si conc_cu contiene más de un registro para un mismo día.
================================================================ */
Concentraciones AS
(
    SELECT
        CAST(c.fecha_registro AS date) AS Fecha,

        AVG(
            TRY_CONVERT(float, c.oxidos_refino_cu)
        ) AS Cu_Refino_Ox,

        AVG(
            TRY_CONVERT(float, c.oxidos_ils_a_piscina_cu)
        ) AS Cu_ILS_Ox,

        AVG(
            TRY_CONVERT(float, c.dump_dpls_cu)
        ) AS Cu_DPLS,

        AVG(
            TRY_CONVERT(float, c.sulfuros_refino_cu)
        ) AS Cu_Refino_Sulf,

        AVG(
            TRY_CONVERT(float, c.sulfuros_ils_a_piscina_cu)
        ) AS Cu_ILS_Sulf

    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.conc_cu AS c

    WHERE CAST(c.fecha_registro AS date)
          BETWEEN @fecha_inicio AND @fecha_fin

    GROUP BY
        CAST(c.fecha_registro AS date)
),

/* ================================================================
   Caudal de cada parcela integrado por duración real
================================================================ */
Riego_Base AS
(
    SELECT
        CAST(v.fecha_registro AS date) AS Fecha,

        UPPER(
            LTRIM(RTRIM(v.pila_codigo))
        ) AS pila_codigo,

        UPPER(
            LTRIM(RTRIM(v.origen_riego))
        ) AS origen_riego,

        TRY_CONVERT(float, v.caudal_riego)
        *
        (
            DATEDIFF_BIG
            (
                SECOND,
                v.fecha_registro,
                v.intervalo_fin
            )
            / 3600.0
        ) AS Volumen

    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.v_riego_parcelas_origen AS v

    WHERE CAST(v.fecha_registro AS date)
          BETWEEN @fecha_inicio AND @fecha_fin

      AND v.intervalo_fin > v.fecha_registro

      AND UPPER(
              LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(v.estado_operacional,'')))
          ) = 'ACTIVO'

      AND TRY_CONVERT(float, v.caudal_riego) >= 0
),

/* ================================================================
   Asignar concentración según PAD + naturaleza
================================================================ */
Riego_Con_Ley AS
(
    SELECT
        r.Fecha,
        r.pila_codigo,
        r.origen_riego,
        r.Volumen,

        CASE

            WHEN r.pila_codigo = 'OX'
             AND r.origen_riego = 'REFINO'
                THEN c.Cu_Refino_Ox

            WHEN r.pila_codigo = 'OX'
             AND r.origen_riego = 'ILS'
                THEN c.Cu_ILS_Ox

            WHEN r.pila_codigo = 'OX'
             AND r.origen_riego = 'DPLS'
                THEN c.Cu_DPLS

            WHEN r.pila_codigo = 'SULF'
             AND r.origen_riego = 'REFINO'
                THEN c.Cu_Refino_Sulf

            WHEN r.pila_codigo = 'SULF'
             AND r.origen_riego = 'ILS'
                THEN c.Cu_ILS_Sulf

            ELSE NULL

        END AS Cu_g_L

    FROM Riego_Base AS r

    LEFT JOIN Concentraciones AS c
        ON c.Fecha = r.Fecha
),

Resumen AS
(
    SELECT
        pila_codigo,
        origen_riego,

        SUM(Volumen) AS Tonelaje,

        SUM
        (
            CASE
                WHEN Volumen > 0
                 AND Cu_g_L IS NULL
                    THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS Registros_Sin_Ley,

        SUM
        (
            CASE
                WHEN Cu_g_L IS NOT NULL
                THEN Volumen * Cu_g_L
            END
        ) AS Suma_Cu_Ponderada,

        SUM
        (
            CASE
                WHEN Cu_g_L IS NOT NULL
                THEN Volumen
            END
        ) AS Volumen_Con_Ley

    FROM Riego_Con_Ley

    WHERE origen_riego IN ('REFINO', 'ILS', 'DPLS')

    GROUP BY
        pila_codigo,
        origen_riego
)

INSERT INTO #flujos_resultado
(
    codigo_flujo,
    Tonelaje,
    Ley_Cu
)

SELECT
    cfg.codigo_flujo,

    CAST(
        COALESCE(r.Tonelaje, 0)
        AS decimal(18,6)
    ) AS Tonelaje,

    CAST
    (
        CASE

            /* No existe ese tipo de riego durante el período */
            WHEN COALESCE(r.Tonelaje,0) = 0
                THEN 0

            /* Hay masa real pero falta concentración:
               no inventar ley */
            WHEN COALESCE(r.Registros_Sin_Ley,0) > 0
                THEN NULL

            ELSE
                (
                    r.Suma_Cu_Ponderada
                    /
                    NULLIF(r.Volumen_Con_Ley,0)
                )
                / 10.0
        END

        AS decimal(18,6)
    ) AS Ley_Cu

FROM Configuracion AS cfg

LEFT JOIN Resumen AS r
    ON  r.pila_codigo = cfg.pila_codigo
    AND r.origen_riego = cfg.origen_riego;

Ley_Diaria AS

                ),

/* ================================================================
   F53 - DPLS HACIA PLS OX
   ----------------------------------------------------------------
   Balance de masa nodo DPLS:

       F37 = F69 + F53 + F71 + F46

   Despejando:

       F53 = F37 - F69 - F71 - F46

   Donde:
       F37 = ingreso desde PAD DUMP
       F69 = variacion inventario DPLS
       F71 = perdida por evaporacion
       F46 = salida hacia PAD Ox
       F53 = salida hacia PLS Ox

   Balance de cobre:

       CuF37 = CuF69 + CuF53 + CuF71 + CuF46

   Como F71 corresponde a evaporacion:
       CuF71 = 0

   Entonces:

       CuF53 = CuF37 - CuF69 - CuF46

   IMPORTANTE:
       - Se elimina el antiguo factor fijo 0.95.
       - La evaporacion queda representada explicitamente por F71.
       - No se fuerza F53 >= 0.
================================================================ */

;WITH F37 AS
(
    SELECT
        COALESCE(TRY_CONVERT(float, Tonelaje), 0) AS Tonelaje,
        COALESCE(TRY_CONVERT(float, Ley_Cu), 0)   AS Ley_Cu
    FROM #flujos_resultado
    WHERE codigo_flujo = 'F37'
),

F46 AS
(
    SELECT
        COALESCE(TRY_CONVERT(float, Tonelaje), 0) AS Tonelaje,
        COALESCE(TRY_CONVERT(float, Ley_Cu), 0)   AS Ley_Cu
    FROM #flujos_resultado
    WHERE codigo_flujo = 'F46'
),

F69 AS
(
    SELECT
        COALESCE(TRY_CONVERT(float, Tonelaje), 0) AS Tonelaje,
        COALESCE(TRY_CONVERT(float, Ley_Cu), 0)   AS Ley_Cu
    FROM #flujos_resultado
    WHERE codigo_flujo = 'F69'
),

F71 AS
(
    SELECT
        COALESCE(TRY_CONVERT(float, Tonelaje), 0) AS Tonelaje,
        COALESCE(TRY_CONVERT(float, Ley_Cu), 0)   AS Ley_Cu
    FROM #flujos_resultado
    WHERE codigo_flujo = 'F71'
),

Calculo AS
(
    SELECT

        /* ========================================================
           MASA
           ======================================================== */
          F37.Tonelaje
        - F69.Tonelaje
        - F71.Tonelaje
        - F46.Tonelaje
            AS Tonelaje_F53,


        /* ========================================================
           COBRE FINO
           ======================================================== */
        (
            F37.Tonelaje
            * F37.Ley_Cu
            / 100.0
        )
        -
        (
            F69.Tonelaje
            * F69.Ley_Cu
            / 100.0
        )
        -
        (
            F46.Tonelaje
            * F46.Ley_Cu
            / 100.0
        )
            AS FCu_F53

    FROM F37
    CROSS JOIN F46
    CROSS JOIN F69
    CROSS JOIN F71
)

         AND FCu_F53 = 0
            THEN 0

        WHEN Tonelaje_F53 = 0
            THEN NULL

        ELSE
            FCu_F53
            / NULLIF(Tonelaje_F53, 0)
            * 100.0
    END

FROM Calculo;

         - Inventario(@fecha_inicio)

       Inventario final  : 17-08-2026

       - No requiere integración temporal ni factor x24.
================================================================ */

;WITH base_f108 AS
(
    SELECT

        /* ========================================================
           INVENTARIO INICIAL

        (

                )

            FROM inventar_SpcHidr.inventario_cobre_colgado_diario AS p

            ORDER BY
                COALESCE(
                    p.updated_at,
                    p.imported_at
                ) DESC,
                p.id_registro DESC

        ) AS Inventario_Inicial,


        /* ========================================================
           INVENTARIO FINAL

        (

)
