        @ton_f23 decimal(18,6) = ISNULL((SELECT Tonelaje FROM #flujos_resultado WHERE codigo_flujo = 'F23'), 0),
        @ley_f23 decimal(18,6) = ISNULL((SELECT Ley_Cu   FROM #flujos_resultado WHERE codigo_flujo = 'F23'), 0),
        @ton_f27 decimal(18,6) = ISNULL((SELECT Tonelaje FROM #flujos_resultado WHERE codigo_flujo = 'F27'), 0),
        @ley_f27 decimal(18,6) = ISNULL((SELECT Ley_Cu   FROM #flujos_resultado WHERE codigo_flujo = 'F27'), 0),
        @ton_f26 decimal(18,6) = ISNULL((SELECT Tonelaje FROM #flujos_resultado WHERE codigo_flujo = 'F26'), 0),
        @ley_f26 decimal(18,6) = ISNULL((SELECT Ley_Cu   FROM #flujos_resultado WHERE codigo_flujo = 'F26'), 0);
    DECLARE
        @ton_f16 decimal(18,6),
        @ley_f16 decimal(18,6),
        @ton_f17 decimal(18,6),
        @ley_f17 decimal(18,6);
    SET @ton_f16 = @ton_f14 - @ton_f18 - @ton_f21;
    SET @ley_f16 = CASE
        WHEN @ton_f16 = 0 THEN 0
        ELSE ((@ton_f14 * @ley_f14) - (@ton_f18 * @ley_f18) - (@ton_f21 * @ley_f21) - (@ton_f24 * @ley_f24)) / @ton_f16
    END;
    SET @ton_f17 = @ton_f15 - @ton_f19 - @ton_f22 ;
    SET @ley_f17 = CASE
        WHEN @ton_f17 = 0 THEN 0
        ELSE ((@ton_f15 * @ley_f15) - (@ton_f19 * @ley_f19) - (@ton_f22 * @ley_f22) - (@ton_f23 * @ley_f23) ) / @ton_f17
    END;
    INSERT INTO #flujos_resultado (codigo_flujo, Tonelaje, Ley_Cu)
    VALUES
        ('F16', @ton_f16, @ley_f16),
        ('F17', @ton_f17, @ley_f17);
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 8d) INVENTARIO INICIAL DE F16 Y F17
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    DECLARE
        @ton14_i decimal(18,6) = 0, @ley14_i decimal(18,6) = 0,
        @ton15_i decimal(18,6) = 0, @ley15_i decimal(18,6) = 0,
        @ton18_i decimal(18,6) = 0, @ley18_i decimal(18,6) = 0,
        @ton19_i decimal(18,6) = 0, @ley19_i decimal(18,6) = 0,
        @ton21_i decimal(18,6) = 0, @ley21_i decimal(18,6) = 0,
        @ton22_i decimal(18,6) = 0, @ley22_i decimal(18,6) = 0,
        @tms_ini_f16 decimal(18,6) = 0, @ley_ini_f16 decimal(18,6) = 0,
        @tms_ini_f17 decimal(18,6) = 0, @ley_ini_f17 decimal(18,6) = 0;
/* ================================================================
   BASE DEL DIA INICIAL PARA F16 / F17
   ----------------------------------------------------------------
   Se mantiene la intención histórica del bloque:

       @ton14_i / @ley14_i = alimentación del día inicial PAD2
       @ton15_i / @ley15_i = alimentación del día inicial PAD1

   CORRECCIONES:
       - Se elimina import_leyes_torres.
       - Se usan las mismas fuentes validadas de F12/F13/F14/F15.
       - control_apilado_diario.fecha YA es fecha operacional.
       - NO se aplica DATEADD(DAY,-1,...).

   IMPORTANTE:
       No se modifica todavía la definición posterior de
       @ton18_i / @ton19_i.
================================================================ */

;WITH Humedad AS
(
    SELECT
        Fecha,
        Turno,
        Humedad_TM1,
        Humedad_TM2

    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.fn_humedad_resuelta_tm_turno_test
    (
        @fecha_inicio,
        DATEADD(DAY, 1, @fecha_inicio)
    )
),

TMH AS
(
    SELECT
        v.Fecha,
        x.Turno,
        x.TM,

        CASE
            WHEN ABS(COALESCE(x.TMH, 0)) > 150000
                THEN 0
            ELSE COALESCE(x.TMH, 0)
        END AS TMH

    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.v_datos_apilado_tmh_v2 AS v

    CROSS APPLY
    (
        VALUES
            ('A', 'TM1', v.TMH_CV008_A),
            ('B', 'TM1', v.TMH_CV008_B),
            ('A', 'TM2', v.TMH_CV108_A),
            ('B', 'TM2', v.TMH_CV108_B)
    ) AS x
    (
        Turno,
        TM,
        TMH
    )

    WHERE v.Fecha = @fecha_inicio
),

Base AS
(
    SELECT
        t.Fecha,
        t.Turno,
        t.TM,
        t.TMH,

        CASE
            WHEN t.TM = 'TM1'
                THEN h.Humedad_TM1

            WHEN t.TM = 'TM2'
                THEN h.Humedad_TM2
        END AS Humedad,

        l.CuT

    FROM TMH AS t

    LEFT JOIN Humedad AS h
        ON  h.Fecha = t.Fecha
        AND h.Turno = t.Turno

    LEFT JOIN inventar_SpcHidr.v_leyes_resueltas_data_tm_reporte_test AS l
        ON  l.Fecha = t.Fecha
        AND l.Turno = t.Turno
        AND l.TM    = t.TM
),

Calculo AS
(
    SELECT
        Fecha,
        Turno,
        TM,
        TMH,
        Humedad,
        CuT,

        CASE
            WHEN TMH = 0
                THEN 0

            WHEN Humedad IS NULL
                THEN NULL

            ELSE
                TMH
                *
                (
                    1.0
                    - TRY_CONVERT(float, Humedad) / 100.0
                )
        END AS TMS,

        CASE
            WHEN TMH = 0
                THEN 0

            WHEN Humedad IS NULL
              OR CuT IS NULL
                THEN NULL

            ELSE
                (
                    TMH
                    *
                    (
                        1.0
                        - TRY_CONVERT(float, Humedad) / 100.0
                    )
                )
                * TRY_CONVERT(float, CuT)
                / 100.0

        END AS FCu

    FROM Base
),

Resumen_Dia AS
(
    SELECT
        /* --------------------------------------------------------
           Masa total TM1 + TM2 del día inicial
           -------------------------------------------------------- */
        CASE
            WHEN SUM
                 (
                     CASE
                         WHEN TMH > 0
                          AND Humedad IS NULL
                             THEN 1
                         ELSE 0
                     END
                 ) > 0
                THEN NULL

            ELSE SUM(TMS)
        END AS TMS_Dia,

        /* --------------------------------------------------------
           Cobre fino total del día inicial
           -------------------------------------------------------- */
        CASE
            WHEN SUM
                 (
                     CASE
                         WHEN TMH > 0
                          AND
                              (
                                  Humedad IS NULL
                                  OR CuT IS NULL
                              )
                             THEN 1
                         ELSE 0
                     END
                 ) > 0
                THEN NULL

            ELSE SUM(FCu)
        END AS FCu_Dia

    FROM Calculo
),

Pad_Dia AS
(
    SELECT
        MAX
        (
            CASE
                WHEN cad.pad_id = 2
                 AND TRY_CONVERT(float, cad.volumen_diario_m3) > 0
                    THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS PAD2_Activo,

        MAX
        (
            CASE
                WHEN cad.pad_id = 1
                 AND TRY_CONVERT(float, cad.volumen_diario_m3) > 0
                    THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS PAD1_Activo

    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.control_apilado_diario AS cad

    /* fecha YA corresponde al día operacional */
    WHERE CAST(cad.fecha AS date) = @fecha_inicio
)

SELECT
    /* ============================================================
       PAD2 -> estado inicial utilizado por F16
       ============================================================ */
    @ton14_i =
        CASE
            WHEN ISNULL(p.PAD2_Activo, 0) = 1
                THEN COALESCE(r.TMS_Dia, 0)
            ELSE 0
        END,

    @ley14_i =
        CASE
            WHEN ISNULL(p.PAD2_Activo, 0) = 0
                THEN 0

            WHEN COALESCE(r.TMS_Dia, 0) = 0
                THEN 0

            ELSE
                COALESCE(r.FCu_Dia, 0)
                / NULLIF(r.TMS_Dia, 0)
                * 100.0
        END,

    /* ============================================================
       PAD1 -> estado inicial utilizado por F17
       ============================================================ */
    @ton15_i =
        CASE
            WHEN ISNULL(p.PAD1_Activo, 0) = 1
                THEN COALESCE(r.TMS_Dia, 0)
            ELSE 0
        END,

    @ley15_i =
        CASE
            WHEN ISNULL(p.PAD1_Activo, 0) = 0
                THEN 0

            WHEN COALESCE(r.TMS_Dia, 0) = 0
                THEN 0

            ELSE
                COALESCE(r.FCu_Dia, 0)
                / NULLIF(r.TMS_Dia, 0)
                * 100.0
        END

FROM Resumen_Dia AS r
CROSS JOIN Pad_Dia AS p;
    SELECT
        @ton18_i = Tonelaje,
        @ley18_i = Ley_Cu
    FROM #tmp_f18_oficial;
    SELECT
        @ton19_i = Tonelaje,
        @ley19_i = Ley_Cu
    FROM #tmp_f19_oficial;
    SET @tms_ini_f16 = @ton14_i - @ton18_i - @ton21_i;
    SET @ley_ini_f16 = CASE
        WHEN @tms_ini_f16 = 0 THEN 0
        ELSE ((@ton14_i * @ley14_i) - (@ton18_i * @ley18_i) - (@ton21_i * @ley21_i)) / @tms_ini_f16
    END;
    SET @tms_ini_f17 = @ton15_i - @ton19_i - @ton22_i;
    SET @ley_ini_f17 = CASE
        WHEN @tms_ini_f17 = 0 THEN 0
        ELSE ((@ton15_i * @ley15_i) - (@ton19_i * @ley19_i) - (@ton22_i * @ley22_i)) / @tms_ini_f17
    END;
    UPDATE #flujos_resultado
       SET TMS_Inicial = @tms_ini_f16,
           Ley_Cu_1    = @ley_ini_f16
     WHERE codigo_flujo = 'F16';
    UPDATE #flujos_resultado
       SET TMS_Inicial = @tms_ini_f17,
           Ley_Cu_1    = @ley_ini_f17
     WHERE codigo_flujo = 'F17';
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 9) SALIDA FINAL
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    SELECT
        codigo_flujo AS Flujo,
        TMS_Inicial,
        Ley_Cu_1,
        TMS_Final,
        Ley_Cu_2,
        Tonelaje,
        Ley_Cu,
        Tonelaje * Ley_Cu / 100.0 AS FCu
    FROM #flujos_resultado
    ORDER BY
        TRY_CONVERT(int, REPLACE(codigo_flujo, 'F', ''));
END;

CREATE PROCEDURE [inventar_SpcHidr].[sp_calcular_balance_flujos_copy1]
(
    @fecha_inicio date,
    @fecha_fin    date
)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 0) NORMALIZAR FECHAS
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    IF @fecha_inicio > @fecha_fin
    BEGIN
        DECLARE @tmp date = @fecha_inicio;
        SET @fecha_inicio = @fecha_fin;
        SET @fecha_fin = @tmp;
    END;

    DECLARE @ff_mas_1 date = DATEADD(DAY, 1, @fecha_fin);

    -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 1) TABLA TEMPORAL DE RESULTADOS
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#flujos_resultado') IS NOT NULL
        DROP TABLE #flujos_resultado;

    CREATE TABLE #flujos_resultado
    (
        codigo_flujo varchar(10)  NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
        TMS_Inicial  decimal(18,6) NULL,
        Ley_Cu_1     decimal(18,6) NULL,
        TMS_Final    decimal(18,6) NULL,
        Ley_Cu_2     decimal(18,6) NULL,
        Tonelaje     decimal(18,6) NULL,
        Ley_Cu       decimal(18,6) NULL
    );

    -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 2) FLUJOS BASE F1..F15, F20..F25
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    -- F1
    INSERT INTO #flujos_resultado (codigo_flujo, Tonelaje, Ley_Cu)
    SELECT
        'F1',
        ISNULL(SUM(Ton), 0),
        ISNULL((SUM(Ton * CuTG00 / 100.0) / NULLIF(SUM(Ton), 0)) * 100.0, 0)
    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.mov_cam
    WHERE fecha BETWEEN @fecha_inicio AND @fecha_fin
      AND Origen = 'Stock'
      AND Fase <> 'SRR'
      AND Destino = 'CH01';

    -- F2
    INSERT INTO #flujos_resultado (codigo_flujo, Tonelaje, Ley_Cu)
    SELECT
        'F2',
        ISNULL(SUM(Ton), 0),
        ISNULL((SUM(Ton * CuTG00 / 100.0) / NULLIF(SUM(Ton), 0)) * 100.0, 0)
    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.mov_cam
    WHERE fecha BETWEEN @fecha_inicio AND @fecha_fin
      AND Origen = 'Mina'
      AND Fase <> 'SRR'
      AND Destino = 'CH01';

    -- F3
    INSERT INTO #flujos_resultado (codigo_flujo, Tonelaje, Ley_Cu)
    SELECT
        'F3',
        ISNULL(SUM(Ton), 0),
        ISNULL((SUM(Ton * CuTG00 / 100.0) / NULLIF(SUM(Ton), 0)) * 100.0, 0)
    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.mov_cam
    WHERE fecha BETWEEN @fecha_inicio AND @fecha_fin
      AND Fase <> 'SRR'
      AND Destino = 'CH01';

    -- F4
    INSERT INTO #flujos_resultado (codigo_flujo, Tonelaje, Ley_Cu)
    SELECT
        'F4',
        ROUND(
            COALESCE((
                SELECT SUM(CV006_tot)
                FROM inventar_SpcHidr.vista_resumen_datos_filtrados
                WHERE fecha_turno >= @fecha_inicio
                  AND fecha_turno < DATEADD(DAY, 1, @fecha_fin)
            ), 0) * (1 - 2.5 / 100.0),
            2
        ) AS Tonelaje,
        COALESCE((
            SELECT (SUM(Ton * CuTG00 / 100.0) / NULLIF(SUM(Ton), 0)) * 100.0
            FROM inventar_SpcHidr.mov_cam
            WHERE fecha BETWEEN @fecha_inicio AND @fecha_fin
              AND Fase <> 'SRR'
              AND Destino = 'CH01'
        ), 0) AS Ley_Cu;

    -- F5
    ;WITH
    tms_i AS (
        SELECT
            AVG(31.1017672705390 * ((v.niv_silo_a + v.niv_silo_b) / 2.0) * (1 - 2.5 / 100.0)) AS total_tms
        FROM inventar_SpcHidr.vista_resumen_datos_filtrados v
        WHERE CAST(v.Fecha_turno AS date) = @fecha_inicio
    ),
    tms_f AS (
        SELECT
            AVG(31.1017672705390 * ((v.niv_silo_a + v.niv_silo_b) / 2.0) * (1 - 2.5 / 100.0)) AS total_tms
        FROM inventar_SpcHidr.vista_resumen_datos_filtrados v
        WHERE CAST(v.Fecha_turno AS date) = @fecha_fin
    ),
    ley_i AS (
        SELECT
            (SUM(Ton * CuTG00 / 100.0) / NULLIF(SUM(Ton), 0)) * 100.0 AS ley_cu
        FROM inventar_SpcHidr.mov_cam
        WHERE fecha = @fecha_inicio
          AND Fase <> 'SRR'
          AND Destino = 'CH01'
    ),
    ley_f AS (
        SELECT
            (SUM(Ton * CuTG00 / 100.0) / NULLIF(SUM(Ton), 0)) * 100.0 AS ley_cu
        FROM inventar_SpcHidr.mov_cam
        WHERE fecha = @fecha_fin
          AND Fase <> 'SRR'
          AND Destino = 'CH01'
    )
    INSERT INTO #flujos_resultado (codigo_flujo, TMS_Inicial, Ley_Cu_1, TMS_Final, Ley_Cu_2, Tonelaje, Ley_Cu)
    SELECT
        'F5',
        COALESCE(tms_i.total_tms, 0) AS TMS_Inicial,
        COALESCE(ley_i.ley_cu, ley_f.ley_cu, 0) AS Ley_Cu_1,
        COALESCE(tms_f.total_tms, 0) AS TMS_Final,
        COALESCE(ley_f.ley_cu, ley_i.ley_cu, 0) AS Ley_Cu_2,
        COALESCE(tms_f.total_tms, 0) - COALESCE(tms_i.total_tms, 0) AS Tonelaje,
        COALESCE(
            (
                (
                    COALESCE(tms_f.total_tms, 0) * COALESCE(ley_f.ley_cu, ley_i.ley_cu, 0) / 100.0
                ) -
                (
                    COALESCE(tms_i.total_tms, 0) * COALESCE(ley_i.ley_cu, ley_f.ley_cu, 0) / 100.0
                )
            ) / NULLIF(COALESCE(tms_f.total_tms, 0) - COALESCE(tms_i.total_tms, 0), 0) * 100.0,
            0
        ) AS Ley_Cu
    FROM tms_i
    CROSS JOIN tms_f
    CROSS JOIN ley_i
    CROSS JOIN ley_f;

    -- F6
    INSERT INTO #flujos_resultado (codigo_flujo, Tonelaje, Ley_Cu)
    SELECT
        'F6',
        (
            ISNULL(
                (
                    SELECT ROUND(SUM(D.tsd), 2)
                    FROM (
                        SELECT
                            SUM(vrdf.cv008_tot) * (1 - AVG(i.Humedades_Dia) / 100.0) AS tsd
                        FROM inventar_SpcHidr.vista_resumen_datos_filtrados vrdf
                        JOIN inventar_SpcHidr.import_leyes_torres i
                            ON CAST(vrdf.fecha_turno AS date) = i.fecha
                        WHERE vrdf.fecha_turno >= @fecha_inicio
                          AND vrdf.fecha_turno < DATEADD(DAY, 1, @fecha_fin)
                          AND i.id_torre = 1
                        GROUP BY CAST(vrdf.fecha_turno AS date)
                    ) D
                ), 0
            )
            - ISNULL(
                (
                    SELECT SUM(cv002_tot) * 0.97
                    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.vista_resumen_datos_filtrados
                    WHERE fecha_turno >= @fecha_inicio
                      AND fecha_turno < DATEADD(DAY, 1, @fecha_fin)
                ), 0
            )
            - ISNULL(
                (
                    SELECT SUM(cv201_tot)
                    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.vista_resumen_datos_filtrados
                    WHERE fecha_turno >= @fecha_inicio
                      AND fecha_turno < DATEADD(DAY, 1, @fecha_fin)
                ), 0
            )
        ) AS Tonelaje,
        (
            (
                ISNULL(
                    (
                        SELECT SUM(D.Finos)
                        FROM (
                            SELECT
                                (SUM(vrdf.cv008_tot) * (1 - AVG(i.Humedades_Dia) / 100.0)) * AVG(i.CuT_Dia) / 100.0 AS Finos
                            FROM inventar_SpcHidr.vista_resumen_datos_filtrados vrdf
                            JOIN inventar_SpcHidr.import_leyes_torres i
                                ON CAST(vrdf.fecha_turno AS date) = i.fecha
                            WHERE vrdf.fecha_turno >= @fecha_inicio
                              AND vrdf.fecha_turno < DATEADD(DAY, 1, @fecha_fin)
                              AND i.id_torre = 1
                            GROUP BY CAST(vrdf.fecha_turno AS date)
                        ) D
                    ), 0
                )
                -
                ISNULL(
                    (
                        SELECT
                            (
                                SELECT SUM(cv002_tot) * 0.97
                                FROM inventar_SpcHidr.vista_resumen_datos_filtrados
                                WHERE fecha_turno >= @fecha_inicio
                                  AND fecha_turno < DATEADD(DAY, 1, @fecha_fin)
                            ) * (
                                SELECT SUM(Ton * CuTG00 / 100.0) / NULLIF(SUM(Ton), 0)
                                FROM inventar_SpcHidr.mov_cam
                                WHERE fecha BETWEEN @fecha_inicio AND @fecha_fin
                                  AND Fase = 'SRR'
                                  AND (Destino = 'prueba' OR Destino = 'CH01')
                            )
                    ), 0
                )
            )
            /
            NULLIF(
                (
                    ISNULL(
                        (
                            SELECT ROUND(SUM(D.tsd), 2)
                            FROM (
                                SELECT
                                    SUM(vrdf.cv008_tot) * (1 - AVG(i.Humedades_Dia) / 100.0) AS tsd
                                FROM inventar_SpcHidr.vista_resumen_datos_filtrados vrdf
                                JOIN inventar_SpcHidr.import_leyes_torres i
                                    ON CAST(vrdf.fecha_turno AS date) = i.fecha
                                WHERE vrdf.fecha_turno >= @fecha_inicio
                                  AND vrdf.fecha_turno < DATEADD(DAY, 1, @fecha_fin)
                                  AND i.id_torre = 1
                                GROUP BY CAST(vrdf.fecha_turno AS date)
                            ) D
                        ), 0
                    )
                    - ISNULL(
                        (
                            SELECT SUM(cv002_tot) * 0.97
                            FROM inventar_SpcHidr.vista_resumen_datos_filtrados
                            WHERE fecha_turno >= @fecha_inicio
                              AND fecha_turno < DATEADD(DAY, 1, @fecha_fin)
                        ), 0
                    )
                    - ISNULL(
                        (
                            SELECT SUM(cv201_tot)
                            FROM inventar_SpcHidr.vista_resumen_datos_filtrados
                            WHERE fecha_turno >= @fecha_inicio
                              AND fecha_turno < DATEADD(DAY, 1, @fecha_fin)
                        ), 0
                    )
                ), 0
            )
        ) * 100.0 AS Ley_Cu;

    -- F7
    INSERT INTO #flujos_resultado (codigo_flujo, Tonelaje, Ley_Cu)
    SELECT
        'F7',
        (
            ISNULL(
                (
                    SELECT ROUND(SUM(D.tsd), 2)
                    FROM (
                        SELECT
                            SUM(vrdf.cv108_tot) * (1 - AVG(i.Humedades_Dia) / 100.0) AS tsd
                        FROM inventar_SpcHidr.vista_resumen_datos_filtrados vrdf
                        JOIN inventar_SpcHidr.import_leyes_torres i
                            ON CAST(vrdf.fecha_turno AS date) = i.fecha
                        WHERE vrdf.fecha_turno >= @fecha_inicio
                          AND vrdf.fecha_turno < DATEADD(DAY, 1, @fecha_fin)
                          AND i.id_torre = 2
                        GROUP BY CAST(vrdf.fecha_turno AS date)
                    ) D
                ), 0
            )
            - ISNULL(
                (
                    SELECT SUM(cv003_tot) * 0.97
                    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.vista_resumen_datos_filtrados
                    WHERE fecha_turno >= @fecha_inicio
                      AND fecha_turno < DATEADD(DAY, 1, @fecha_fin)
                ), 0
            )
            - ISNULL(
                (
                    SELECT SUM(cv202_tot)
                    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.vista_resumen_datos_filtrados
                    WHERE fecha_turno >= @fecha_inicio
                      AND fecha_turno < DATEADD(DAY, 1, @fecha_fin)
                ), 0
            )
        ) AS Tonelaje,
        (
            (
                ISNULL(
                    (
                        SELECT SUM(D.Finos)
                        FROM (
                            SELECT
                                (SUM(vrdf.cv108_tot) * (1 - AVG(i.Humedades_Dia) / 100.0)) * AVG(i.CuT_Dia) / 100.0 AS Finos
                            FROM inventar_SpcHidr.vista_resumen_datos_filtrados vrdf
                            JOIN inventar_SpcHidr.import_leyes_torres i
                                ON CAST(vrdf.fecha_turno AS date) = i.fecha
                            WHERE vrdf.fecha_turno >= @fecha_inicio
                              AND vrdf.fecha_turno < DATEADD(DAY, 1, @fecha_fin)
                              AND i.id_torre = 2
                            GROUP BY CAST(vrdf.fecha_turno AS date)
                        ) D
                    ), 0
                )
                -
                ISNULL(
                    (
                        SELECT
                            (
                                SELECT SUM(cv003_tot) * 0.97
                                FROM inventar_SpcHidr.vista_resumen_datos_filtrados
                                WHERE fecha_turno >= @fecha_inicio
                                  AND fecha_turno < DATEADD(DAY, 1, @fecha_fin)
                            ) * (
                                SELECT SUM(Ton * CuTG00 / 100.0) / NULLIF(SUM(Ton), 0)
                                FROM inventar_SpcHidr.mov_cam

    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#tmp_f18_oficial') IS NOT NULL

    ;WITH
    Tms_Apilado_Por_Modulo AS (
        SELECT
            mt.[campaña_id],
            mt.modulo_id,
            SUM(mt.TMS) AS tms_total_apilado
        FROM inventar_SpcHidr.modulos_turnos mt
        GROUP BY mt.[campaña_id], mt.modulo_id
    ),
    Pct_Diario AS (
        SELECT
            CAST(crd.fecha AS date) AS fecha,
            crd.pad_id,
            crd.[campaña_id],
            crd.modulo_id,
            CASE
                WHEN MAX(crd.avance_porcentaje) < 0 THEN 0
                WHEN MAX(crd.avance_porcentaje) > 1 THEN 1
                ELSE MAX(crd.avance_porcentaje)
            END AS pct_clip
        FROM inventar_SpcHidr.control_reclamo_diario crd
        WHERE CAST(crd.fecha AS date) BETWEEN @fecha_inicio AND DATEADD(DAY, 1, @fecha_fin)
        GROUP BY CAST(crd.fecha AS date), crd.pad_id, crd.[campaña_id], crd.modulo_id
    ),
    Pct_Segmentado AS (
        SELECT
            p.*,
            CASE
                WHEN p.pct_clip < LAG(p.pct_clip, 1, 0) OVER (
                    PARTITION BY p.[campaña_id], p.modulo_id, p.pad_id
                    ORDER BY p.fecha
                ) THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END AS reset_flag
        FROM Pct_Diario p
    ),
    Pct_Seg_Id AS (
        SELECT
            ps.*,
            SUM(ps.reset_flag) OVER (
                PARTITION BY ps.[campaña_id], ps.modulo_id, ps.pad_id
                ORDER BY ps.fecha
                ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
            ) AS seg_id
        FROM Pct_Segmentado ps
    ),
    Avance_Incremental_Diario AS (
        SELECT
            p.fecha,
            p.pad_id,
            p.[campaña_id],
            p.modulo_id,
            p.pct_clip AS avance_porcentaje,
            CASE
                WHEN (p.pct_clip - LAG(p.pct_clip, 1, 0) OVER (
                    PARTITION BY p.[campaña_id], p.modulo_id, p.pad_id, p.seg_id
                    ORDER BY p.fecha
                )) < 0 THEN 0
                ELSE (p.pct_clip - LAG(p.pct_clip, 1, 0) OVER (
                    PARTITION BY p.[campaña_id], p.modulo_id, p.pad_id, p.seg_id
                    ORDER BY p.fecha
                ))
            END AS avance_incremental
        FROM Pct_Seg_Id p
    ),
    Volumen_Diario AS (
        SELECT
            CAST(fecha AS date) AS fecha,
            pad_id,
            [campaña_id],
            modulo_id,
            MAX(volumen_diario_m3) AS vol_m3
        FROM inventar_SpcHidr.control_reclamo_diario
        WHERE CAST(fecha AS date) BETWEEN @fecha_inicio AND DATEADD(DAY, 1, @fecha_fin)
        GROUP BY CAST(fecha AS date), pad_id, [campaña_id], modulo_id
    ),
    Reclamo_Diario AS (
        SELECT
            DATEADD(DAY, -1, a.fecha) AS fecha_operacion,
            a.[campaña_id],
            a.modulo_id,
            (tm.tms_total_apilado * a.avance_incremental) AS tonelaje_reclamado_diario
        FROM Avance_Incremental_Diario a
        JOIN Tms_Apilado_Por_Modulo tm
          ON tm.[campaña_id] = a.[campaña_id]
         AND tm.modulo_id = a.modulo_id
        JOIN Volumen_Diario vd
          ON vd.fecha = a.fecha
         AND vd.pad_id = a.pad_id
         AND vd.[campaña_id] = a.[campaña_id]
         AND vd.modulo_id = a.modulo_id
        WHERE a.pad_id = 2
          AND vd.vol_m3 > 0
    ),
    Calculo_Tonelaje AS (
        SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.tonelaje_reclamado_diario), 0) AS Tonelaje
        FROM Reclamo_Diario r
        WHERE r.fecha_operacion BETWEEN @fecha_inicio AND @fecha_fin
    ),
    ModulosActivos AS (
        SELECT
            r.[campaña_id],
            r.modulo_id,
            SUM(r.tonelaje_reclamado_diario) AS tms_reclamado_modulo
        FROM Reclamo_Diario r
        WHERE r.fecha_operacion BETWEEN @fecha_inicio AND @fecha_fin
        GROUP BY r.[campaña_id], r.modulo_id
        HAVING SUM(r.tonelaje_reclamado_diario) > 0
    ),
    Calculo_Ley AS (
        SELECT
            COALESCE(
                (
                    SUM(ma.tms_reclamado_modulo * clr.ley_ripio / 100.0)
                    / NULLIF(SUM(ma.tms_reclamado_modulo), 0)
                ) * 100.0,
                0
            ) AS Ley_Cu
        FROM ModulosActivos ma
        INNER JOIN inventar_SpcHidr.campaña c
            ON ma.[campaña_id] = c.[id_campaña]
        INNER JOIN inventar_SpcHidr.modulo m
            ON ma.modulo_id = m.id_modulo
        INNER JOIN inventar_SpcHidr.parcela p
            ON m.id_parcela = p.id_parcela
        INNER JOIN inventar_SpcHidr.pad pd
            ON p.id_pad = pd.id_pad
        INNER JOIN inventar_SpcHidr.control_ley_ripio clr
            ON clr.Campana = c.[numero_campaña]
           AND clr.Parcela = p.numero
           AND UPPER(clr.PAD) LIKE UPPER(pd.nombre) + '%'
        WHERE pd.id_pad = 2
    )
    SELECT
        t.Tonelaje,
        l.Ley_Cu
    INTO #tmp_f18_oficial
    FROM Calculo_Tonelaje t
    CROSS JOIN Calculo_Ley l;

-- Balance del nodo Feed DUMP:
--     Entradas = F52 + F120
--     Salidas  = F38 + F70 + F72

CREATE PROCEDURE
[inventar_SpcHidr].[sp_reporte_datos_conciliados_test]
(
    @FechaInicio date = NULL,
    @FechaFin    date = NULL
)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET XACT_ABORT ON;

    /* ============================================================
       1. VALIDACIÓN DE PARÁMETROS
       ============================================================ */

    IF @FechaInicio IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT
            @FechaInicio = MIN(CAST(Fecha AS date))
        FROM [inventar_SpcHidr].[Datos_conciliados_of];
    END;

    IF @FechaFin IS NULL
    BEGIN
        SELECT
            @FechaFin = MAX(CAST(Fecha AS date))
        FROM [inventar_SpcHidr].[Datos_conciliados_of];
    END;

    IF @FechaInicio IS NULL OR @FechaFin IS NULL
    BEGIN
        THROW 50002,
              'No fue posible determinar el rango de fechas del reporte.',
              1;
    END;

    IF @FechaInicio > @FechaFin
    BEGIN
        THROW 50001,
              'La fecha inicial no puede ser mayor que la fecha final.',
              1;
    END;

    /*
       La función diaria utiliza fecha final exclusiva.
    */
    DECLARE @FechaFinExclusiva date =
        DATEADD(DAY, 1, @FechaFin);


    /* ============================================================
       2. CALENDARIO + SELECCIÓN HISTÓRICA
       ============================================================ */

    ;WITH Fechas AS
    (
        SELECT
            @FechaInicio AS Fecha

        UNION ALL

        SELECT
            DATEADD(DAY, 1, Fecha)
        FROM Fechas
        WHERE Fecha < @FechaFin
    ),

    DatosBase AS
    (
        SELECT
            d.*,

            ROW_NUMBER() OVER
            (
                PARTITION BY CAST(d.Fecha AS date)

                ORDER BY
                    /*
                       Preferencia por avances en escala interna 0–1.
                    */
                    CASE
                        WHEN
                            (
                                d.Avance_apilado IS NULL
                                OR d.Avance_apilado BETWEEN 0 AND 1
                            )
                            AND
                            (
                                d.Avance_reclamo_oxidos IS NULL
                                OR d.Avance_reclamo_oxidos BETWEEN 0 AND 1
                            )
                            AND
                            (
                                d.Avance_reclamo_sulfuros IS NULL
                                OR d.Avance_reclamo_sulfuros BETWEEN 0 AND 1
                            )
                        THEN 0
                        ELSE 1
                    END,

                    /*
                       Preferencia temporal por registros de chancado
                       que conserven decimales.
                    */
                    CASE
                        WHEN ABS
                        (
                            COALESCE(d.Chancado_TMS_Real, 0)
                            - ROUND
                            (
                                COALESCE(d.Chancado_TMS_Real, 0),
                                0
                            )
                        ) > 0.000001
                        THEN 0
                        ELSE 1
                    END,

                    /*
                       Desempate técnico temporal.
                       Debe reemplazarse por ID o fecha de actualización
                       cuando esos campos estén disponibles.
                    */
                    CHECKSUM
                    (
                        d.Fecha,
                        d.Chancado_TMS_Real,
                        d.Apilado_TMS_Real,
                        d.Avance_apilado,
                        d.Avance_reclamo_oxidos,
                        d.Avance_reclamo_sulfuros,
                        d.Produccion_Catodos_Real
                    ) DESC
            ) AS rn

        FROM [inventar_SpcHidr].[Datos_conciliados_of] d

        WHERE CAST(d.Fecha AS date) >= @FechaInicio
          AND CAST(d.Fecha AS date) <= @FechaFin
    ),

    DatosUnicos AS
    (
        SELECT *
        FROM DatosBase
        WHERE rn = 1
    )

    SELECT
        f.Fecha,

        /* ========================================================
           CHANCADO
           Fuente histórica temporal
           ======================================================== */

        d.Chancado_TMS_Real,


        /* ========================================================
           HUMEDAD
           ======================================================== */

        a.Humedad_Turno_A,
        a.Humedad_Turno_B,
        a.Humedad_promedio_dia,


        /* ========================================================
           SAL
           ======================================================== */

        a.Sal_turno_A,
        a.Sal_Turno_B,
        a.Sal_promedio_dia,


        /* ========================================================
           APILADO TMH
           ======================================================== */

        a.Apilado_TMH_turno_A,
        a.Apilado_TMH_turno_B,
        a.Apilado_TMH_promedio_dia,


        /* ========================================================
           APILADO TMS
           Consolidación oficial Turno → Día
           ======================================================== */

        g.Apilado_TMS_Real_Dia
            AS Apilado_TMS_Real,

        g.Apilado_TMS_Plan
            AS Apilado_TMS_Plan,


        /* ========================================================
           MATERIAL, MÓDULO Y AVANCE
           ======================================================== */

        CASE
            WHEN UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(g.Material_Operacion)))
                IN ('SULFURO', 'SULFUROS')
                THEN 'Sulfuro'

            WHEN UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(g.Material_Operacion)))
                IN ('OXIDO', 'OXIDOS', 'ÓXIDO', 'ÓXIDOS')
                THEN 'Oxido'

            ELSE g.Material_Operacion
        END AS Campana_apilado,

        g.Modulo
            AS Modulo_apilado,

        g.Avance
            AS Avance_apilado,


        /* ========================================================
           LEY CuT DEL APILADO
           ======================================================== */

        g.CuT_Real_Dia
            AS Ley_CuT_Real,

        g.CuT_Plan
            AS Ley_CuT_Plan,


        /* ========================================================
           COBRE FINO APILADO

           Sin apilado:
           cobre fino = 0.

           Con apilado pero sin CuT:
           cobre fino = NULL.
           ======================================================== */

        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(g.Apilado_TMS_Real_Dia, 0) = 0
                THEN CAST(0 AS decimal(20,6))

            WHEN g.CuT_Real_Dia IS NULL
                THEN NULL

            ELSE
                CAST
                (
                    g.Apilado_TMS_Real_Dia
                    * g.CuT_Real_Dia
                    / 100.0
                    AS decimal(20,6)
                )
        END AS Cobre_fino_Apilado_Real,

        CASE
            WHEN g.Apilado_TMS_Plan IS NULL
              OR g.CuT_Plan IS NULL
                THEN NULL

            ELSE
                CAST
                (
                    g.Apilado_TMS_Plan
                    * g.CuT_Plan
                    / 100.0
                    AS decimal(20,6)
                )
        END AS Cobre_fino_Apilado_Plan,


        /* ========================================================
           RECLAMO ÓXIDOS
           Fuente histórica temporal
           ======================================================== */

        d.TMS_Rotopala_1_Real,

        pm.TMS_Rotopala_1_Plan
            AS TMS_Rotopala_1_Plan,

        d.Campana_reclamo_oxidos,
        d.Modulo_reclamo_oxidos,
        d.Avance_reclamo_oxidos,


        /* ========================================================
           RECLAMO SULFUROS
           Fuente histórica temporal
           ======================================================== */

        d.TMS_Rotopala_2_Real,

        pm.TMS_Rotopala_2_Plan
            AS TMS_Rotopala_2_Plan,

        d.Campana_reclamo_sulfuros,
        d.modulo_reclamo_sulfuros,
        d.Avance_reclamo_sulfuros,


        /* ========================================================
           CAMIONES
           Fuente histórica temporal
           ======================================================== */

        d.Camiones_TMS_Reclamo_Oxidos,
        d.Camiones_TMS_Reclamo_Sulfuros,

        d.Movido,
        d.Extraido,

        d.Camiones_TMS_total,

        pm.Camiones_TMS_Plan
            AS Camiones_TMS_plan,

        d.Campana_reclamo_camiones,
        d.Modulo_reclamo_camiones,


        /* ========================================================
           RIPIOS

           Real:
           histórico temporal.

           Plan:
           Rotopala 1 + Rotopala 2 + Camiones.
           ======================================================== */

        d.Total_Ripios_Incluye_Camiones_Real,

        CASE
            WHEN pm.TMS_Rotopala_1_Plan IS NOT NULL
             AND pm.TMS_Rotopala_2_Plan IS NOT NULL
             AND pm.Camiones_TMS_Plan IS NOT NULL
            THEN
                CAST(pm.TMS_Rotopala_1_Plan AS decimal(20,3))
                + CAST(pm.TMS_Rotopala_2_Plan AS decimal(20,3))
                + CAST(pm.Camiones_TMS_Plan AS decimal(20,3))

            ELSE
                d.Total_Ripios_Incluye_Camiones_Plan
        END AS Total_Ripios_Incluye_Camiones_Plan,


        /* ========================================================
           PRODUCCIÓN CATÓDICA
           ======================================================== */

        p.Produccion_Catodos_Real
            AS Produccion_Catodos_Real,

        pm.Produccion_Catodos_Plan
            AS Produccion_Catodos_Plan,


        /* ========================================================
           SRR REAL

           Fuente primaria:
           v_srr_tms_diario_test.

           Fallback:
           Datos_conciliados_of.
           ======================================================== */

        CASE
            WHEN s.Flag_SRR_TMS_Dia = 'OK'
                THEN s.SRR_TMS_Turno_A

            ELSE d.SRR_TMS_Turno_A
        END AS SRR_TMS_Turno_A,

        CASE
            WHEN s.Flag_SRR_TMS_Dia = 'OK'
                THEN s.SRR_TMS_Turno_B

            ELSE d.SRR_TMS_Turno_B
        END AS SRR_TMS_Turno_B,

        CASE
            WHEN s.Flag_SRR_TMS_Dia = 'OK'
                THEN s.SRR_TMS_Dia

            ELSE d.SRR_TMS_promedio_dia
        END AS SRR_TMS_promedio_dia,

        pm.SRR_TMS_Plan
            AS SRR_TMS_Plan,

        d.Ley_CuT_Real_srr,

        pm.Ley_CuT_Plan_SRR
            AS Ley_CuT_Plan_srr,


        /* ========================================================
           ESTADO HISTÓRICO
           ======================================================== */

        d.estado,


        /* ========================================================
           TRAZABILIDAD DE FUENTES
           ======================================================== */

        CASE
            WHEN d.Fecha IS NOT NULL
                THEN 'DATOS_CONCILIADOS_OF_TEMPORAL'
            ELSE 'SIN_DATO'
        END AS Fuente_Chancado,

        CASE
            WHEN a.Fecha IS NOT NULL
                THEN 'REPORTE_DIARIO_APILADO_TEST'
            ELSE 'SIN_DATO'
        END AS Fuente_Humedad,

        CASE
            WHEN a.Fecha IS NOT NULL
                THEN 'PESOMETROS_CORREGIDOS_Y_TOPOGRAFIA'
            ELSE 'SIN_DATO'
        END AS Fuente_Sal,

        CASE
            WHEN g.Fecha IS NOT NULL
                THEN 'FN_GENERADOR_REPORTE_DIARIO'
            ELSE 'SIN_DATO'
        END AS Fuente_Apilado,

        CASE
            WHEN d.Fecha IS NOT NULL
                THEN 'DATOS_CONCILIADOS_OF_TEMPORAL'
            ELSE 'SIN_DATO'
        END AS Fuente_Reclamo,

        CASE
            WHEN p.Fecha IS NOT NULL
                THEN 'PRODUCCION_CATODICA'
            ELSE 'SIN_DATO'
        END AS Fuente_Produccion_Catodos,

        CASE
            WHEN s.Flag_SRR_TMS_Dia = 'OK'
                THEN 'CALCULO_SRR_TEST'

            WHEN d.SRR_TMS_promedio_dia IS NOT NULL
                THEN 'DATOS_CONCILIADOS_OF_FALLBACK'

            ELSE 'SIN_DATO'
        END AS Fuente_SRR,


        /* ========================================================
           BANDERAS DE CONTROL
           ======================================================== */

        CASE
            WHEN d.Fecha IS NOT NULL
                THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS Flag_Historico_Disponible,

        CASE
            WHEN s.Flag_SRR_TMS_Dia = 'OK'
                THEN 0

            WHEN d.SRR_TMS_promedio_dia IS NOT NULL
                THEN 1

            ELSE 0
        END AS Flag_SRR_Fallback,

        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(g.Apilado_TMS_Real_Dia, 0) > 0
             AND g.CuT_Real_Dia IS NULL
                THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS Flag_Ley_Apilado_Faltante,

        CASE
            WHEN p.Produccion_Catodos_Real IS NULL
                THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS Flag_Produccion_Catodos_Faltante,


        /* ========================================================
           ESTADO GENERAL DEL CÁLCULO
           ======================================================== */

        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(g.Apilado_TMS_Real_Dia, 0) > 0
             AND g.CuT_Real_Dia IS NULL
                THEN 'REVISAR LEY APILADO'

            WHEN s.Flag_SRR_TMS_Dia <> 'OK'
             AND d.SRR_TMS_promedio_dia IS NOT NULL
                THEN 'CON FALLBACK SRR'

            WHEN p.Produccion_Catodos_Real IS NULL
                THEN 'REVISAR PRODUCCION CATODICA'

            WHEN d.Fecha IS NULL
                THEN 'SIN BASE HISTORICA'

            ELSE 'OK'
        END AS Estado_Calculo

    FROM Fechas f

    LEFT JOIN DatosUnicos d
        ON CAST(d.Fecha AS date) = f.Fecha

    LEFT JOIN
        [inventar_SpcHidr].[v_reporte_diario_apilado_test] a
        ON CAST(a.Fecha AS date) = f.Fecha

    LEFT JOIN
        [inventar_SpcHidr].[fn_generador_reporte_diario]
        (
            @FechaInicio,
            @FechaFinExclusiva
        ) g
        ON CAST(g.Fecha AS date) = f.Fecha

    LEFT JOIN
        [inventar_SpcHidr].[v_srr_tms_diario_test] s
        ON CAST(s.Fecha AS date) = f.Fecha

    LEFT JOIN
        [inventar_SpcHidr].[v_produccion_catodica_diaria_test] p
        ON CAST(p.Fecha AS date) = f.Fecha

    LEFT JOIN
        [inventar_SpcHidr].[v_planes_mensuales_diarios_test] pm
        ON CAST(pm.Fecha AS date) = f.Fecha

    ORDER BY
        f.Fecha

    OPTION (MAXRECURSION 32767);

END;

CREATE PROCEDURE [inventar_SpcHidr].[sp_calcular_balance_flujos_v2]
(
    @fecha_inicio date,
    @fecha_fin    date
)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

    -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 0) NORMALIZAR FECHAS
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    IF @fecha_inicio > @fecha_fin
    BEGIN
        DECLARE @tmp date = @fecha_inicio;
        SET @fecha_inicio = @fecha_fin;
        SET @fecha_fin = @tmp;
    END;

    DECLARE @ff_mas_1 date = DATEADD(DAY, 1, @fecha_fin);

    -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 1) TABLA TEMPORAL DE RESULTADOS
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#flujos_resultado') IS NOT NULL
        DROP TABLE #flujos_resultado;

    CREATE TABLE #flujos_resultado
    (
        codigo_flujo varchar(10)  NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
        TMS_Inicial  decimal(18,6) NULL,
        Ley_Cu_1     decimal(18,6) NULL,
        TMS_Final    decimal(18,6) NULL,
        Ley_Cu_2     decimal(18,6) NULL,
        Tonelaje     decimal(18,6) NULL,
        Ley_Cu       decimal(18,6) NULL
    );

    -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 2) FLUJOS BASE F1..F15, F20..F25
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    -- F1
    INSERT INTO #flujos_resultado (codigo_flujo, Tonelaje, Ley_Cu)
    SELECT
        'F1',
        ISNULL(SUM(Ton), 0),
        ISNULL((SUM(Ton * CuTG00 / 100.0) / NULLIF(SUM(Ton), 0)) * 100.0, 0)
    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.mov_cam
    WHERE fecha BETWEEN @fecha_inicio AND @fecha_fin
      AND Origen = 'Stock'
      AND Fase <> 'SRR'
      AND Destino = 'CH01';

    -- F2
    INSERT INTO #flujos_resultado (codigo_flujo, Tonelaje, Ley_Cu)
    SELECT
        'F2',
        ISNULL(SUM(Ton), 0),
        ISNULL((SUM(Ton * CuTG00 / 100.0) / NULLIF(SUM(Ton), 0)) * 100.0, 0)
    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.mov_cam
    WHERE fecha BETWEEN @fecha_inicio AND @fecha_fin
      AND Origen = 'Mina'
      AND Fase <> 'SRR'
      AND Destino = 'CH01';

    -- F3
    INSERT INTO #flujos_resultado (codigo_flujo, Tonelaje, Ley_Cu)
    SELECT
        'F3',
        ISNULL(SUM(Ton), 0),
        ISNULL((SUM(Ton * CuTG00 / 100.0) / NULLIF(SUM(Ton), 0)) * 100.0, 0)
    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.mov_cam
    WHERE fecha BETWEEN @fecha_inicio AND @fecha_fin
      AND Fase <> 'SRR'
      AND Destino = 'CH01';

    -- F4
    INSERT INTO #flujos_resultado (codigo_flujo, Tonelaje, Ley_Cu)
    SELECT
        'F4',
        ROUND(
            COALESCE((
                SELECT SUM(CV006_tot)
                FROM inventar_SpcHidr.vista_resumen_datos_filtrados
                WHERE fecha_turno >= @fecha_inicio
                  AND fecha_turno < DATEADD(DAY, 1, @fecha_fin)
            ), 0) * (1 - 2.5 / 100.0),
            2
        ) AS Tonelaje,
        COALESCE((
            SELECT (SUM(Ton * CuTG00 / 100.0) / NULLIF(SUM(Ton), 0)) * 100.0
            FROM inventar_SpcHidr.mov_cam
            WHERE fecha BETWEEN @fecha_inicio AND @fecha_fin
              AND Fase <> 'SRR'
              AND Destino = 'CH01'
        ), 0) AS Ley_Cu;

    -- F5
    ;WITH
    tms_i AS (
        SELECT AVG(31.1017672705390 * ((v.niv_silo_a + v.niv_silo_b) / 2.0) * (1 - 2.5 / 100.0)) AS total_tms
        FROM inventar_SpcHidr.vista_resumen_datos_filtrados v
        WHERE CAST(v.Fecha_turno AS date) = @fecha_inicio
    ),
    tms_f AS (
        SELECT AVG(31.1017672705390 * ((v.niv_silo_a + v.niv_silo_b) / 2.0) * (1 - 2.5 / 100.0)) AS total_tms
        FROM inventar_SpcHidr.vista_resumen_datos_filtrados v
        WHERE CAST(v.Fecha_turno AS date) = @fecha_fin
    ),
    ley_i AS (
        SELECT (SUM(Ton * CuTG00 / 100.0) / NULLIF(SUM(Ton), 0)) * 100.0 AS ley_cu
        FROM inventar_SpcHidr.mov_cam
        WHERE fecha = @fecha_inicio AND Fase <> 'SRR' AND Destino = 'CH01'
    ),
    ley_f AS (
        SELECT (SUM(Ton * CuTG00 / 100.0) / NULLIF(SUM(Ton), 0)) * 100.0 AS ley_cu
        FROM inventar_SpcHidr.mov_cam
        WHERE fecha = @fecha_fin AND Fase <> 'SRR' AND Destino = 'CH01'
    )
    INSERT INTO #flujos_resultado (codigo_flujo, TMS_Inicial, Ley_Cu_1, TMS_Final, Ley_Cu_2, Tonelaje, Ley_Cu)
    SELECT
        'F5',
        COALESCE(tms_i.total_tms, 0),
        COALESCE(ley_i.ley_cu, ley_f.ley_cu, 0),
        COALESCE(tms_f.total_tms, 0),
        COALESCE(ley_f.ley_cu, ley_i.ley_cu, 0),
        COALESCE(tms_f.total_tms, 0) - COALESCE(tms_i.total_tms, 0),
        COALESCE(
            ((COALESCE(tms_f.total_tms,0)*COALESCE(ley_f.ley_cu,ley_i.ley_cu,0)/100.0)
            -(COALESCE(tms_i.total_tms,0)*COALESCE(ley_i.ley_cu,ley_f.ley_cu,0)/100.0))
            / NULLIF(COALESCE(tms_f.total_tms,0)-COALESCE(tms_i.total_tms,0),0)*100.0, 0)
    FROM tms_i CROSS JOIN tms_f CROSS JOIN ley_i CROSS JOIN ley_f;

    -- F6
    INSERT INTO #flujos_resultado (codigo_flujo, Tonelaje, Ley_Cu)
    SELECT 'F6',
        (ISNULL((SELECT ROUND(SUM(D.tsd),2) FROM (
            SELECT SUM(vrdf.cv008_tot)*(1-AVG(i.Humedades_Dia)/100.0) AS tsd
            FROM inventar_SpcHidr.vista_resumen_datos_filtrados vrdf
            JOIN inventar_SpcHidr.import_leyes_torres i ON CAST(vrdf.fecha_turno AS date)=i.fecha
            WHERE vrdf.fecha_turno>=@fecha_inicio AND vrdf.fecha_turno<DATEADD(DAY,1,@fecha_fin) AND i.id_torre=1
            GROUP BY CAST(vrdf.fecha_turno AS date)) D),0)
        -ISNULL((SELECT SUM(cv002_tot)*0.97 FROM inventar_SpcHidr.vista_resumen_datos_filtrados WHERE fecha_turno>=@fecha_inicio AND fecha_turno<DATEADD(DAY,1,@fecha_fin)),0)
        -ISNULL((SELECT SUM(cv201_tot) FROM inventar_SpcHidr.vista_resumen_datos_filtrados WHERE fecha_turno>=@fecha_inicio AND fecha_turno<DATEADD(DAY,1,@fecha_fin)),0)) AS Tonelaje,
        ((ISNULL((SELECT SUM(D.Finos) FROM (
            SELECT (SUM(vrdf.cv008_tot)*(1-AVG(i.Humedades_Dia)/100.0))*AVG(i.CuT_Dia)/100.0 AS Finos
            FROM inventar_SpcHidr.vista_resumen_datos_filtrados vrdf
            JOIN inventar_SpcHidr.import_leyes_torres i ON CAST(vrdf.fecha_turno AS date)=i.fecha
            WHERE vrdf.fecha_turno>=@fecha_inicio AND vrdf.fecha_turno<DATEADD(DAY,1,@fecha_fin) AND i.id_torre=1
            GROUP BY CAST(vrdf.fecha_turno AS date)) D),0)
        -ISNULL((SELECT SUM(cv002_tot)*0.97 FROM inventar_SpcHidr.vista_resumen_datos_filtrados WHERE fecha_turno>=@fecha_inicio AND fecha_turno<DATEADD(DAY,1,@fecha_fin))*
            (SELECT SUM(Ton*CuTG00/100.0)/NULLIF(SUM(Ton),0) FROM inventar_SpcHidr.mov_cam WHERE fecha BETWEEN @fecha_inicio AND @fecha_fin AND Fase='SRR' AND (Destino='prueba' OR Destino='CH01')),0))
        /NULLIF((ISNULL((SELECT ROUND(SUM(D.tsd),2) FROM (
            SELECT SUM(vrdf.cv008_tot)*(1-AVG(i.Humedades_Dia)/100.0) AS tsd
            FROM inventar_SpcHidr.vista_resumen_datos_filtrados vrdf
            JOIN inventar_SpcHidr.import_leyes_torres i ON CAST(vrdf.fecha_turno AS date)=i.fecha
            WHERE vrdf.fecha_turno>=@fecha_inicio AND vrdf.fecha_turno<DATEADD(DAY,1,@fecha_fin) AND i.id_torre=1
            GROUP BY CAST(vrdf.fecha_turno AS date)) D),0)
        -ISNULL((SELECT SUM(cv002_tot)*0.97 FROM inventar_SpcHidr.vista_resumen_datos_filtrados WHERE fecha_turno>=@fecha_inicio AND fecha_turno<DATEADD(DAY,1,@fecha_fin)),0)
        -ISNULL((SELECT SUM(cv201_tot) FROM inventar_SpcHidr.vista_resumen_datos_filtrados WHERE fecha_turno>=@fecha_inicio AND fecha_turno<DATEADD(DAY,1,@fecha_fin)),0)),0))*100.0 AS Ley_Cu;

    -- F7
    INSERT INTO #flujos_resultado (codigo_flujo, Tonelaje, Ley_Cu)
    SELECT 'F7',
        (ISNULL((SELECT ROUND(SUM(D.tsd),2) FROM (
            SELECT SUM(vrdf.cv108_tot)*(1-AVG(i.Humedades_Dia)/100.0) AS tsd
            FROM inventar_SpcHidr.vista_resumen_datos_filtrados vrdf
            JOIN inventar_SpcHidr.import_leyes_torres i ON CAST(vrdf.fecha_turno AS date)=i.fecha
            WHERE vrdf.fecha_turno>=@fecha_inicio AND vrdf.fecha_turno<DATEADD(DAY,1,@fecha_fin) AND i.id_torre=2
            GROUP BY CAST(vrdf.fecha_turno AS date)) D),0)
        -ISNULL((SELECT SUM(cv003_tot)*0.97 FROM inventar_SpcHidr.vista_resumen_datos_filtrados WHERE fecha_turno>=@fecha_inicio AND fecha_turno<DATEADD(DAY,1,@fecha_fin)),0)
        -ISNULL((SELECT SUM(cv202_tot) FROM inventar_SpcHidr.vista_resumen_datos_filtrados WHERE fecha_turno>=@fecha_inicio AND fecha_turno<DATEADD(DAY,1,@fecha_fin)),0)) AS Tonelaje,
        ((ISNULL((SELECT SUM(D.Finos) FROM (
            SELECT (SUM(vrdf.cv108_tot)*(1-AVG(i.Humedades_Dia)/100.0))*AVG(i.CuT_Dia)/100.0 AS Finos
            FROM inventar_SpcHidr.vista_resumen_datos_filtrados vrdf
            JOIN inventar_SpcHidr.import_leyes_torres i ON CAST(vrdf.fecha_turno AS date)=i.fecha
            WHERE vrdf.fecha_turno>=@fecha_inicio AND vrdf.fecha_turno<DATEADD(DAY,1,@fecha_fin) AND i.id_torre=2
            GROUP BY CAST(vrdf.fecha_turno AS date)) D),0)
        -ISNULL((SELECT SUM(cv003_tot)*0.97 FROM inventar_SpcHidr.vista_resumen_datos_filtrados WHERE fecha_turno>=@fecha_inicio AND fecha_turno<DATEADD(DAY,1,@fecha_fin))*
            (SELECT SUM(Ton*CuTG00/100.0)/NULLIF(SUM(Ton),0) FROM inventar_SpcHidr.mov_cam WHERE fecha BETWEEN @fecha_inicio AND @fecha_fin AND Fase='SRR' AND (Destino='prueba' OR Destino='CH01')),0))
        /NULLIF((ISNULL((SELECT ROUND(SUM(D.tsd),2) FROM (
            SELECT SUM(vrdf.cv108_tot)*(1-AVG(i.Humedades_Dia)/100.0) AS tsd
            FROM inventar_SpcHidr.vista_resumen_datos_filtrados vrdf
            JOIN inventar_SpcHidr.import_leyes_torres i ON CAST(vrdf.fecha_turno AS date)=i.fecha
            WHERE vrdf.fecha_turno>=@fecha_inicio AND vrdf.fecha_turno<DATEADD(DAY,1,@fecha_fin) AND i.id_torre=2
            GROUP BY CAST(vrdf.fecha_turno AS date)) D),0)
        -ISNULL((SELECT SUM(cv003_tot)*0.97 FROM inventar_SpcHidr.vista_resumen_datos_filtrados WHERE fecha_turno>=@fecha_inicio AND fecha_turno<DATEADD(DAY,1,@fecha_fin)),0)
        -ISNULL((SELECT SUM(cv202_tot) FROM inventar_SpcHidr.vista_resumen_datos_filtrados WHERE fecha_turno>=@fecha_inicio AND fecha_turno<DATEADD(DAY,1,@fecha_fin)),0)),0))*100.0 AS Ley_Cu;

    -- F8
    INSERT INTO #flujos_resultado (codigo_flujo, Tonelaje, Ley_Cu)
    SELECT 'F8',
        ISNULL((SELECT SUM(cv002_tot)*0.97 FROM inventar_SpcHidr.vista_resumen_datos_filtrados WHERE fecha_turno>=@fecha_inicio AND fecha_turno<DATEADD(DAY,1,@fecha_fin)),0),
        ISNULL((SELECT (SUM(Ton*CuTG00/100.0)/NULLIF(SUM(Ton),0))*100.0 FROM inventar_SpcHidr.mov_cam WHERE fecha BETWEEN @fecha_inicio AND @fecha_fin AND Fase='SRR' AND (Destino='prueba' OR Destino='CH01')),0);

    -- F9
    INSERT INTO #flujos_resultado (codigo_flujo, Tonelaje, Ley_Cu)
    SELECT 'F9',
        ISNULL((SELECT SUM(cv003_tot)*0.97 FROM inventar_SpcHidr.vista_resumen_datos_filtrados WHERE fecha_turno>=@fecha_inicio AND fecha_turno<DATEADD(DAY,1,@fecha_fin)),0),
        ISNULL((SELECT (SUM(Ton*CuTG00/100.0)/NULLIF(SUM(Ton),0))*100.0 FROM inventar_SpcHidr.mov_cam WHERE fecha BETWEEN @fecha_inicio AND @fecha_fin AND Fase='SRR' AND (Destino='prueba' OR Destino='CH01')),0);

    -- F10
    INSERT INTO #flujos_resultado (codigo_flujo, Tonelaje, Ley_Cu)
    SELECT 'F10', ISNULL(SUM(cv201_tot),0), 0
    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.vista_resumen_datos_filtrados
    WHERE fecha_turno>=@fecha_inicio AND fecha_turno<DATEADD(DAY,1,@fecha_fin);

    -- F11
    INSERT INTO #flujos_resultado (codigo_flujo, Tonelaje, Ley_Cu)
    SELECT 'F11', ISNULL(SUM(cv202_tot),0), 0
    FROM inventar_SpcHidr.vista_resumen_datos_filtrados
    WHERE fecha_turno>=@fecha_inicio AND fecha_turno<DATEADD(DAY,1,@fecha_fin);

    ;WITH
    Tms_Apilado_Por_Modulo AS (
        SELECT mt.[campaña_id], mt.modulo_id, SUM(mt.TMS) AS tms_total_apilado
        FROM inventar_SpcHidr.modulos_turnos mt
        GROUP BY mt.[campaña_id], mt.modulo_id
    ),
    Pct_Diario AS (
        SELECT CAST(crd.fecha AS date) AS fecha, crd.pad_id, crd.[campaña_id], crd.modulo_id,
            CASE WHEN MAX(crd.avance_porcentaje)<0 THEN 0 WHEN MAX(crd.avance_porcentaje)>1 THEN 1
                 ELSE MAX(crd.avance_porcentaje) END AS pct_clip
        FROM inventar_SpcHidr.control_reclamo_diario crd
        WHERE CAST(crd.fecha AS date) BETWEEN @fecha_inicio AND DATEADD(DAY,1,@fecha_fin)
        GROUP BY CAST(crd.fecha AS date), crd.pad_id, crd.[campaña_id], crd.modulo_id
    ),
    Pct_Segmentado AS (
        SELECT p.*,
            CASE WHEN p.pct_clip < LAG(p.pct_clip,1,0) OVER (PARTITION BY p.[campaña_id],p.modulo_id,p.pad_id ORDER BY p.fecha) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS reset_flag
        FROM Pct_Diario p
    ),
    Pct_Seg_Id AS (
        SELECT ps.*,
            SUM(ps.reset_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY ps.[campaña_id],ps.modulo_id,ps.pad_id ORDER BY ps.fecha ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS seg_id
        FROM Pct_Segmentado ps
    ),
    Avance_Incremental_Diario AS (
        SELECT p.fecha, p.pad_id, p.[campaña_id], p.modulo_id, p.pct_clip AS avance_porcentaje,
            CASE WHEN (p.pct_clip-LAG(p.pct_clip,1,0) OVER (PARTITION BY p.[campaña_id],p.modulo_id,p.pad_id,p.seg_id ORDER BY p.fecha))<0 THEN 0
                 ELSE (p.pct_clip-LAG(p.pct_clip,1,0) OVER (PARTITION BY p.[campaña_id],p.modulo_id,p.pad_id,p.seg_id ORDER BY p.fecha)) END AS avance_incremental
        FROM Pct_Seg_Id p
    ),
    Volumen_Diario AS (
        SELECT CAST(fecha AS date) AS fecha, pad_id, [campaña_id], modulo_id, MAX(volumen_diario_m3) AS vol_m3
        FROM inventar_SpcHidr.control_reclamo_diario
        WHERE CAST(fecha AS date) BETWEEN @fecha_inicio AND DATEADD(DAY,1,@fecha_fin)
        GROUP BY CAST(fecha AS date), pad_id, [campaña_id], modulo_id
    ),
    Reclamo_Diario AS (
        SELECT DATEADD(DAY,-1,a.fecha) AS fecha_operacion, a.[campaña_id], a.modulo_id,
            (tm.tms_total_apilado*a.avance_incremental) AS tonelaje_reclamado_diario
        FROM Avance_Incremental_Diario a
        JOIN Tms_Apilado_Por_Modulo tm ON tm.[campaña_id]=a.[campaña_id] AND tm.modulo_id=a.modulo_id
        JOIN Volumen_Diario vd ON vd.fecha=a.fecha AND vd.pad_id=a.pad_id AND vd.[campaña_id]=a.[campaña_id] AND vd.modulo_id=a.modulo_id
        WHERE a.pad_id=2 AND vd.vol_m3>0
    ),
    Calculo_Tonelaje AS (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.tonelaje_reclamado_diario),0) AS Tonelaje FROM Reclamo_Diario r WHERE r.fecha_operacion BETWEEN @fecha_inicio AND @fecha_fin),
    ModulosActivos AS (
        SELECT r.[campaña_id], r.modulo_id, SUM(r.tonelaje_reclamado_diario) AS tms_reclamado_modulo
        FROM Reclamo_Diario r WHERE r.fecha_operacion BETWEEN @fecha_inicio AND @fecha_fin
        GROUP BY r.[campaña_id], r.modulo_id HAVING SUM(r.tonelaje_reclamado_diario)>0
    ),
    Calculo_Ley AS (
        SELECT COALESCE((SUM(ma.tms_reclamado_modulo*clr.ley_ripio/100.0)/NULLIF(SUM(ma.tms_reclamado_modulo),0))*100.0,0) AS Ley_Cu
        FROM ModulosActivos ma
        INNER JOIN inventar_SpcHidr.campaña c ON ma.[campaña_id]=c.[id_campaña]
        INNER JOIN inventar_SpcHidr.modulo m ON ma.modulo_id=m.id_modulo
        INNER JOIN inventar_SpcHidr.parcela p ON m.id_parcela=p.id_parcela
        INNER JOIN inventar_SpcHidr.pad pd ON p.id_pad=pd.id_pad
        INNER JOIN inventar_SpcHidr.control_ley_ripio clr ON clr.Campana=c.[numero_campaña] AND clr.Parcela=p.numero AND UPPER(clr.PAD) LIKE UPPER(pd.nombre)+'%'
        WHERE pd.id_pad=2
    )
